items.title_en: Barrier-Shaped Recurrent Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Landing on a Heaving Ship Deck
items.title_zh: 面向升沉船甲板自主着陆的障碍形状循环强化学习
items.abstract_en: This paper addresses autonomous landing of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) rotorcrafts on a heaving ship deck using a recurrent policy trained via asymmetric actor-critic reinforcement learning: the critic sees 6 s of future deck height during training, while the actor sees only what the onboard sensors provide in flight, a 17-dimensional state made of the vehicle's position, velocity and attitude relative to the deck and outputs world-frame velocity and yaw-rate commands. Training is performed across 4096 parallel simulated environments, followed by fine-tuning in 16 environments with an onboard vision pipeline in the loop. A control-barrier-function (CBF) stopping margin on the deck-relative vertical state is incorporated at two stages: as a reward term during training, where it halves the median simulated contact speed relative to a policy trained without it, and as a runtime safety filter at deployment, evaluated at every control step to abort and retry the descent when the margin is violated. Because the autopilot's disarm logic cannot detect the vehicle resting on a moving deck, proximity-based thrust cutoff at touchdown is commanded directly in the landing pipeline. The proposed approach is validated using a parallel-manipulator-platform-based deck emulator that reproduces the heaving motion of the ship deck (scaled to 0.70 m peak-to-peak, 7.5 s mean period) and a quadcopter UAV with an onboard camera. Across 31 motion-capture and 20 vision-based trials, the UAV landed every time, with median times to contact of 6.5 and 7.3 s; 77% and 50% landed on the first attempt, with mean deck-relative speeds of 0.29 and 0.27 m/s, respectively, at the instant of thrust cutoff, which is the last speed under the policy's control. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/S5hDkrSZJt4
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究无人机（UAV）旋翼机在起伏船甲板上的自主着陆问题，采用通过非对称演员-评论家强化学习训练的循环策略：训练时评论家可看到未来 6 s 的甲板高度，而演员只能看到飞行中机载传感器提供的信息，即由飞行器相对甲板的位置、速度和姿态构成的 17 维状态，并输出世界坐标系下的速度和偏航角速率指令。训练在 4096 个并行仿真环境中进行，随后在 16 个环境中进行微调，并在回路中接入机载视觉流程。针对甲板相对的垂直状态，在两个方面引入控制屏障函数（CBF）停止裕度：训练时作为奖励项，与未使用该项训练的策略相比，可将仿真中接触速度的中位数减半；部署时作为运行时安全滤波器，在每个控制步进行评估，当裕度被违反时中止并重试下降。由于自驾仪的解除武装（disarm）逻辑无法检测到飞行器停放在运动甲板上，着陆流程中直接下达基于接近度的触地推力切断指令。所提方法通过基于并联机械臂平台的甲板模拟器（复现船甲板的起伏运动，缩放至峰峰值 0.70 m、平均周期 7.5 s）以及搭载机载相机的四旋翼无人机进行验证。在 31 次动作捕捉试验和 20 次基于视觉的试验中，无人机每次均成功着陆，接触时间中位数分别为 6.5 s 和 7.3 s；分别有 77% 和 50% 在首次尝试中着陆，推力切断瞬间（即策略控制的最后一个速度点）的平均甲板相对速度分别为 0.29 m/s 和 0.27 m/s。补充视频：https://youtu.be/S5hDkrSZJt4
items.comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 1 table. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA). Video: https://youtu.be/S5hDkrSZJt4

items.title_en: Battery-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Aggressive Quadrotor Flight
items.title_zh: 面向激进四旋翼飞行的电池感知强化学习
items.abstract_en: Agile flight tasks such as drone racing and pursuit-evasion require strong acceleration and precise turns, but the available thrust changes as the battery discharges and voltage drops under load. Conservative command limits make this variation easier to tolerate, at the cost of unused performance. We investigate how learned controllers can use that additional thrust while retaining the flight controller's voltage compensation and rate control. Our training simulator couples an identified load-transient battery model to rotor dynamics and firmware saturation. The feedforward policy receives filtered voltage during both training and deployment. Controlled ablations distinguish the benefit of a larger thrust-command range from that of voltage information. On a 38 g Crazyflie Brushless, the resulting policy reduces circle tracking error by 49% relative to stock-authority RL at 3.84 m/s, while preserving easy-task precision. Mean 20-lap race time decreases from 106.22 s to 95.24 s. Compared with a voltage-blind policy with the same increased authority, hardware error and race time are lower by 15.3% and 4.5%, respectively. In simulation, replacing the policy's voltage input with a recording from a different battery condition worsens hard-circle tracking, with a smaller, voltage-dependent effect in racing. Together, these results show where a simple voltage input complements existing actuator compensation in aggressive learned flight.
items.abstract_zh: 无人机竞速和追逃等敏捷飞行任务需要强加速度和精确转向，但可用推力会随电池放电以及负载下电压下降而变化。保守的指令限制使这种变化更易被容忍，代价是性能未被充分利用。我们研究了学习型控制器如何在保留飞控电压补偿与角速率控制的同时利用这部分额外推力。我们的训练模拟器将辨识得到的负载瞬态电池模型与旋翼动力学和固件饱和耦合。前馈策略在训练和部署时均接收经过滤波的电压。受控消融实验区分了更大推力指令范围的收益与电压信息的收益。在 38 g 的 Crazyflie Brushless 上，所得策略在 3.84 m/s 时相较原授权范围的强化学习将圆周跟踪误差降低 49%，同时保持简单任务精度。20 圈竞速平均时间从 106.22 s 降至 95.24 s。与具有相同扩大授权范围但无电压信息的策略相比，硬件误差和竞速时间分别降低 15.3% 和 4.5%。在仿真中，将策略的电压输入替换为来自不同电池状态的记录会使难圆周跟踪变差，在竞速中影响较小且依赖电压。这些结果共同表明，在敏捷学习飞行中，简单的电压输入可在何处补充现有的执行器补偿。

items.title_en: RAVEN: A Unified Active SLAM System for Rapid Autonomous Visual Exploration with Aerial Robots under Localization Uncertainty
items.title_zh: RAVEN：面向空中机器人在定位不确定性下快速自主视觉探索的统一主动 SLAM 系统
items.abstract_en: Active simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) addresses the problem of planning robot motion to build complete and accurate maps of unknown environments through efficient exploration while maintaining high localization accuracy. This raises a dilemma between exploring unknown spaces to expand coverage and exploiting visited regions to perform active loop closures. Despite numerous prior works on ground robots, aerial robots with high agility and constrained sensor suites face more significant localization drift and thereby demand dedicated active SLAM planning. Moreover, a unified strategy that adapts performance based on task-specific priorities remains an open question. In this article, we introduce RAVEN, a unified active SLAM framework for Rapid Autonomous Visual ExploratioN using quadrotors, which systematically accounts for localization uncertainty. The framework starts with identifying frontiers and active loop closure candidates, from which global tour candidates are generated. These candidates are evaluated using a utility vector that separately quantifies exploration efficiency and localization accuracy, and the final tour is selected according to a prioritization parameter ranging from $[0,1]$. Finally, a perception-aware navigation planner generates smooth execution trajectories that minimize visual state estimation error based on the online Fisher information field that provides visual localization information in real-time. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate that RAVEN outperforms state-of-the-art active SLAM methods, highlighting its advantages in producing a spectrum of performance across prioritizations. Fully onboard field experiments with a customized stereo-inertial quadrotor further validate its practical applicability in challenging environments. The source code will be released to benefit the community.
items.abstract_zh: 主动同时定位与建图（SLAM）解决的是通过高效探索规划机器人运动，以在未知环境中构建完整、准确地图并保持高定位精度的问题。这带来了在探索未知空间以扩大覆盖与利用已访问区域进行主动回环闭合之间的两难。尽管地面机器人已有大量先前工作，但具有高敏捷性和受限传感器配置的空中机器人面临更显著的定位漂移，因而需要专门的主动 SLAM 规划。此外，能够根据任务特定优先级自适应调整性能的统一策略仍是一个开放问题。本文提出 RAVEN，一个用于四旋翼快速自主视觉探索（Rapid Autonomous Visual ExploratioN）并系统考虑定位不确定性的统一主动 SLAM 框架。该框架首先识别前沿和主动回环闭合候选，并由此生成全局巡游候选。这些候选通过一个分别量化探索效率和定位精度的效用向量进行评估，最终巡游依据取值范围为 [0,1] 的优先级参数进行选择。最后，感知感知导航规划器基于实时提供视觉定位信息的在线 Fisher 信息场，生成使视觉状态估计误差最小化的平滑执行轨迹。基准评测表明 RAVEN 优于当前最先进的主动 SLAM 方法，凸显其在不同优先级下产生一系列性能表现的优势。使用定制立体-惯性四旋翼进行的完全机载现场实验进一步验证了其在挑战性环境中的实际适用性。源代码将发布以惠及社区。
items.comment: Conditionally accepted to the IEEE Transactions on Robotics

items.title_en: AgilePE: Autonomous UAV Pursuit-Evasion via Self-Play Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: AgilePE：基于自博弈强化学习的自主无人机追逃
items.abstract_en: Autonomous pursuit-evasion is a fundamental challenge for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), requiring rapid decision-making under tightly coupled dynamics and continuously changing opponent behaviors. Traditional rule-based or differential-game approaches often struggle with high-dimensional aerial interactions and agile maneuvering. We present AgilePE, a complete system for autonomous UAV pursuit-evasion via self-play reinforcement learning. AgilePE integrates agile low-level control, competitive policy optimization, and sim-to-real deployment in a unified framework. The policy directly maps onboard state observations to Collective Thrust and Body Rates (CTBR) commands, enabling end-to-end agile maneuvering without intermediate trajectory planners or waypoint controllers. For training, we use competitive self-play with Prioritized Fictitious Self-Play (PFSP) and a diversified opponent pool, enabling agents to improve against historical policies while stabilizing optimization and reducing policy oscillation. This process leads to the emergence of sophisticated pursuit and evasion strategies. For real-world deployment, we develop a hardware-aligned simulation pipeline that models actuator-response dynamics, communication latency, and domain randomization. The learned policies transfer zero-shot to real quadrotors without task-specific tuning. Real-world experiments reproduce pursuit-evasion tactics observed in simulation, including rapid dodging and flanking, and demonstrate interactive two-agent zero-shot deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 自主追逃是无人机（UAV）的一项基本挑战，需要在紧耦合动力学和持续变化的对手行为下快速决策。传统的基于规则或微分博弈的方法往往难以应对高维空中交互和敏捷机动。我们提出 AgilePE，一个通过自博弈强化学习实现无人机自主追逃的完整系统。AgilePE 将敏捷底层控制、竞争性策略优化和仿真到现实部署集成于统一框架中。该策略直接将机载状态观测映射为总推力与机体角速率（CTBR）指令，实现端到端敏捷机动，无需中间轨迹规划器或航点控制器。在训练方面，我们采用带优先虚拟自博弈（PFSP）的竞争性自博弈以及多样化的对手池，使智能体能够针对历史策略持续改进，同时稳定优化并减少策略振荡。这一过程促成了复杂追逃策略的涌现。针对真实世界部署，我们开发了一个硬件对齐的仿真流程，对执行器响应动力学、通信延迟和域随机化进行建模。学习所得策略零样本迁移到真实四旋翼上，无需任务特定调参。真实世界实验复现了仿真中观察到的追逃战术，包括快速闪避和侧翼包抄，并展示了交互式双智能体零样本部署。

items.title_en: Omni-IGN: Onboard Image-Goal Navigation for Drones with Omnidirectional Vision
items.title_zh: Omni-IGN：面向无人机全向视觉的机载图像目标导航
items.abstract_en: Image-goal navigation (ImageNav) requires an agent to reach a location specified by a goal image in an unknown environment. For drones, this task demands exploration, goal- directed navigation, and collision avoidance under limited onboard computing resources. Existing aerial ImageNav methods are built on single-view observations, requiring additional rotation and exploration to search for goal-relevant cues outside the field of view. In this paper, we present Omni-IGN, a fully onboard ImageNav system that integrates quad-fisheye perception, an attention-based reinforcement learning (RL) policy, and a collision-aware safety layer. The policy adaptively fuses goal-relevant features across multiple views to provide directional guidance for continuous navigation. The quad-fisheye RGB images support both ImageNav and obstacle avoidance without a dedicated depth sensor. On Habitat benchmarks, Omni-IGN achieves the best performance among continuous-action baselines. Moreover, flight tests in IsaacSim validate the effectiveness of integrating learning-based depth estimation with the action safety layer for collision avoidance. Finally, real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer without any fine-tuning or external localization. The code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.
items.abstract_zh: 图像目标导航（ImageNav）要求智能体在未知环境中到达由目标图像指定的位置。对无人机而言，该任务需要在有限的机载计算资源下完成探索、目标导向导航和避障。现有的空中 ImageNav 方法基于单视角观测构建，需要额外旋转和探索以搜索视场外的目标相关线索。本文提出 Omni-IGN，一个完全机载的 ImageNav 系统，集成了四鱼眼感知、基于注意力的强化学习（RL）策略和碰撞感知安全层。该策略自适应地融合多视角中的目标相关特征，为连续导航提供方向引导。四鱼眼 RGB 图像同时支持 ImageNav 和避障，无需专用深度传感器。在 Habitat 基准上，Omni-IGN 在连续动作基线中取得最佳性能。此外，IsaacSim 中的飞行测试验证了将学习型深度估计与动作安全层结合用于避障的有效性。最后，真实世界实验展示了无需任何微调或外部定位的零样本仿真到现实迁移。代码和模型检查点将在接收后发布。

items.title_en: TransNav: Transformer-Based End-to-End Navigation Method for Static and Dynamic Quadrotor Obstacle Avoidance
items.title_zh: TransNav：基于 Transformer 的静态与动态四旋翼避障端到端导航方法
items.abstract_en: Obstacle avoidance for autonomous quadrotors in cluttered environments remains challenging, especially when both dense static obstacles and moving obstacles are present. Existing methods are often tailored to either static or dynamic settings, which always limit their adaptability across diverse environments. This paper presents TransNav, a transformer-based end-to-end navigation method for quadrotor obstacle avoidance in both static and dynamic environments. TransNav employs a patch-based point-cloud encoding scheme that combines local feature extraction with global contextual modeling, enabling compact yet informative environment representation. The method integrates perception and navigation in a single architecture and directly predicts a finite-horizon action sequence, from which the first action is executed. Moreover, we develop an unsupervised learning strategy by incorporating a lightweight point-mass dynamics model, which directly optimizes trajectory-level costs over the predicted sequence through numerical gradient propagation. Thus, the policy can be efficiently trained without expert demonstrations. Simulation and real-world experiments show that the proposed method achieves strong performance in dense static environments and competitive obstacle-avoidance capability in dynamic scenarios, while maintaining low inference cost for onboard deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 自主四旋翼在杂乱环境中的避障仍具挑战，尤其是当密集静态障碍物和移动障碍物同时存在时。现有方法往往针对静态或动态环境之一而设计，这常常限制了它们在不同环境间的适应性。本文提出 TransNav，一种基于 Transformer 的端到端导航方法，用于四旋翼在静态和动态环境中的避障。TransNav 采用基于块（patch）的点云编码方案，将局部特征提取与全局上下文建模相结合，实现紧凑而信息丰富的环境表示。该方法在单一架构中集成感知与导航，并直接预测有限时域的动作序列，执行其中的第一个动作。此外，我们通过引入轻量级质点动力学模型开发了一种无监督学习策略，该策略通过数值梯度传播直接针对预测序列上的轨迹级代价进行优化。因此，策略无需专家示范即可高效训练。仿真与真实世界实验表明，所提方法在密集静态环境中取得强劲性能，在动态场景中具有竞争力的避障能力，同时保持较低的推理开销以支持机载部署。

items.title_en: Rendering-Free Event Frame Simulation for Fast Reinforcement Learning of Autonomous Robot Navigation
items.title_zh: 面向自主机器人导航快速强化学习的免渲染事件帧仿真
items.abstract_en: Event cameras offer low latency, high dynamic range, and milliwatt-level power consumption, making them ideal for agile robots such as tiny drones navigating through cluttered environments. However, existing simulators generally render photorealistic images before converting them into events, making large-scale reinforcement learning prohibitively slow. We propose an analytic event simulator that exploits what event cameras fundamentally measure - moving contrast edges - to synthesize event streams directly from scene geometry and ego-motion without visual rendering. Our simulator generates a 64x64 event observation in 17 microseconds on a single GPU - over 400x faster than a state-of-the-art rendering pipeline - enabling end-to-end reinforcement learning for goal-directed obstacle avoidance to converge in under 30 minutes - three orders of magnitude faster than training on rendered events. Policies transfer zero-shot to physically based event simulations (ray-traced Isaac Sim). Our policy reaches 83% success in cluttered courses unseen during training (mid-difficulty, traversability probability approx. 0.57), at 2.4 m/s average goal velocity, and retains 70% in a simulated texture-dense indoor hall. Furthermore, we quantized the policy to a 1.2 MB int8 network running fully onboard a 56-gram Crazyflie equipped with a Prophesee GenX320 event camera and an OpenMV N6 microcontroller board. Without any fine-tuning, external processing, or positioning, the policy achieves an average success rate of 82% (5/5, 5/6, 4/6 flights) across three real-world obstacle courses of increasing difficulty. Code: https://github.com/tudelft/rendering-free-event-nav
items.abstract_zh: 事件相机具有低延迟、高动态范围和毫瓦级功耗，使其非常适合在杂乱环境中导航的微型无人机等敏捷机器人。然而，现有仿真器通常先渲染照片级真实图像再转换为事件，导致大规模强化学习慢得难以承受。我们提出一种解析事件仿真器，利用事件相机本质上测量的内容——运动对比度边缘——直接从场景几何和自运动合成事件流，而无需视觉渲染。我们的仿真器在单块 GPU 上于 17 微秒内生成 64x64 事件观测，比最先进的渲染流水线快 400 倍以上，使目标导向避障的端到端强化学习在 30 分钟内收敛，比在渲染事件上训练快三个数量级。策略零样本迁移到基于物理的事件仿真（光线追踪 Isaac Sim）。我们的策略在训练中未见过的杂乱赛道（中等难度，可通行概率约 0.57）中达到 83% 成功率，平均目标速度为 2.4 m/s，并在模拟的纹理密集室内大厅中保持 70%。此外，我们将策略量化为 1.2 MB 的 int8 网络，完全在搭载 Prophesee GenX320 事件相机和 OpenMV N6 微控制器板的 56 克 Crazyflie 上运行。无需任何微调、外部处理或定位，该策略在三条难度递增的真实世界障碍赛道中平均成功率达到 82%（5/5、5/6、4/6 次飞行）。代码：https://github.com/tudelft/rendering-free-event-nav
authors: Guido C. H. E. de Croon

items.title_en: SwarmNxt: Open-source Software-Hardware Platform for Fast and Agile Aerial Swarms
items.title_zh: SwarmNxt：面向快速敏捷空中集群的开源软硬件平台
items.abstract_en: Aerial robot swarms have the potential to transform time-critical safety, security, and search-and-rescue operations. By coordinating multiple robots, they can rapidly survey disaster sites, map collapsed or GPS-denied environments, and search cluttered areas faster than a single robot, reducing response times and minimizing risks to first responders. Realizing this potential, however, requires robust autonomous swarm navigation, which remains an active research challenge. Progress is further constrained by existing platforms, as commercial drones are often closed-source or lack the onboard computational resources needed for agile, vision-based collective flight. Moreover, developing, deploying, and maintaining software across multiple aerial robots requires significant engineering effort. To address these challenges, we present SwarmNxt, an open-source software platform built on the open-source OmniNxt drone hardware. SwarmNxt provides an end-to-end toolkit, including detailed hardware assembly instructions with a video tutorial, automation tools for parallel software deployment and swarm-wide updates, and a ROS 2-based framework for autonomous navigation. The platform integrates state-of-the-art control, planning, and depth estimation into a single ROS 2 multi-agent system, providing an open research infrastructure for physical swarm experimentation. We validate SwarmNxt through two real-world experiments: a six-drone swarm performing decentralized planning with high-speed inter-drone collision avoidance, and a four-drone swarm executing collective flight with onboard depth estimation in an obstacle-filled environment. Both experiments were run indoors with global position from external motion capture; perception, planning, and control run onboard.
items.abstract_zh: 空中机器人集群有潜力改变时间关键的安全、安保和搜救行动。通过协调多个机器人，它们可以比单个机器人更快地勘察灾害现场、绘制倒塌或 GPS 拒止环境地图并搜索杂乱区域，从而缩短响应时间并最大限度降低第一响应人员的风险。然而，实现这一潜力需要稳健的自主集群导航，这仍是一个活跃的研究挑战。现有平台进一步限制了进展，因为商用无人机通常闭源或缺乏敏捷、基于视觉的集体飞行所需的机载计算资源。此外，在多架空中机器人上开发、部署和维护软件需要大量工程投入。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 SwarmNxt，一个构建在开源 OmniNxt 无人机硬件上的开源软件平台。SwarmNxt 提供端到端工具包，包括带有视频教程的详细硬件组装说明、用于并行软件部署和集群范围更新的自动化工具，以及基于 ROS 2 的自主导航框架。该平台将最先进的控制、规划和深度估计集成到单个 ROS 2 多智能体系统中，为物理集群实验提供开放研究基础设施。我们通过两个真实世界实验验证 SwarmNxt：一个六无人机集群执行去中心化规划并进行高速机间避碰，以及一个四无人机集群在充满障碍的环境中执行带有板载深度估计的集体飞行。两个实验均在室内运行，全局位置来自外部动作捕捉；感知、规划和控制均在机载运行。

items.title_en: PILOT: Privileged Imitation Learning for End-to-End Motion Planning of Autonomous UAVs under Partial Observability
items.title_zh: PILOT：部分可观测条件下自主无人机端到端运动规划的特权模仿学习
items.abstract_en: Autonomous navigation in cluttered environments is hampered by partial observability and dynamic constraints. This paper presents PILOT, a constraint-aware privileged imitation learning framework for vision-based end-to-end UAV motion planning under partial observability. The framework distills planning strategies from a computationally intensive optimal control expert into a student policy regularized toward safety and dynamic requirements via a dual-objective loss function. To mitigate partial observability, a spatiotemporal perception fusion module using a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) is developed to integrate historical depth images and odometry. This module infers task-relevant latent context from historical observations, enhancing spatial awareness beyond the instantaneous FOV without maintaining persistent map memory. A trajectory parameterization layer mapping network outputs to a structured trajectory, while enabling explicit continuity, dynamic-consistency, and obstacle soft penalties during training, encouraging constraint satisfaction for unseen observations without formal guarantees. Simulations on quadrotor and fixed-wing aircraft demonstrate that PILOT achieves performance comparable to the privileged expert while reducing computational overhead by over 80\%. Successful indoor and outdoor zero-shot deployment confirms the practical feasibility and cross-domain generalization of the planner.
items.abstract_zh: 杂乱环境中的自主导航受到部分可观测性和动态约束的阻碍。本文提出 PILOT，一个约束感知的特权模仿学习框架，用于部分可观测条件下基于视觉的无人机端到端运动规划。该框架将计算密集的最优控制专家的规划策略蒸馏到学生策略中，并通过双目标损失函数对学生策略朝着安全和动态要求进行正则化。为缓解部分可观测性，开发了一个使用时间卷积网络（TCN）的时空感知融合模块，以融合历史深度图像和里程计。该模块从历史观测中推断任务相关的潜在上下文，在不维护持久地图记忆的情况下增强超出瞬时视场的空间感知。轨迹参数化层将网络输出映射为结构化轨迹，同时在训练期间启用显式连续性、动态一致性和障碍物软惩罚，鼓励对未见观测满足约束，但无形式化保证。在四旋翼和固定翼飞机上的仿真表明，PILOT 达到与特权专家相当的性能，同时将计算开销降低超过 80%。成功的室内外零样本部署证实了该规划器的实际可行性和跨域泛化能力。

items.title_en: Interruption-Aware Recurrent Reinforcement Learning for UAS Navigation Under Temporary Overrides
items.title_zh: 面向临时接管下无人机系统导航的中断感知循环强化学习
items.abstract_en: Safe autonomous navigation of UASs requires tactical deconfliction to address conflicts that strategic coordination cannot prevent. This task is challenging under partial observability, when sensor or traffic data are missing, delayed, or degraded. Geometry-based methods can offer separation assurances but face limitations in dense encounters. Recurrent reinforcement learning has therefore been proposed to learn navigation policies that integrate observation-action histories to optimise long-term safety-efficiency trade-offs. However, operational safeguards may require a remote pilot, onboard detect-and-avoid system, or runtime assurance mechanism to temporarily override the learned policy. A research gap remains in understanding how these interruptions affect recurrent policies when the agent regains authority. Benchmark evidence shows that interruptions make task variables less decodable from the recurrent hidden state and increase post-interruption collision risk. The findings suggest that altered recurrent context prolongs post-handback degradation through an action-observation feedback loop, in which changed actions alter the flight path and subsequent recurrent updates. To address this vulnerability, we propose three interruption-aware architectures that condition recurrent processing on interruption context through separate feature streams, dedicated interruption memory, or gated environmental features. Across simulations, all three architectures preserve more decodable task information than a standard recurrent policy. Moreover, the strongest architecture reduces post-interruption collisions by 74% and interruption-induced mission failures by 69% relative to the recurrent baseline, without degrading interruption-free performance. These results show that safe interruption does not guarantee safe handback, and support interruption-aware recurrent design for resilient UAS autonomy.
items.abstract_zh: UAS 的安全自主导航需要战术解冲突，以处理战略协调无法预防的冲突。当传感器或交通数据缺失、延迟或降级时，该任务在部分可观测下具有挑战性。基于几何的方法可以提供间隔保证，但在密集相遇中面临局限。因此，循环强化学习已被提出用于学习导航策略，这些策略整合观测-动作历史以优化长期安全-效率权衡。然而，运行安全保障可能要求远程飞行员、机载探测与避让系统或运行时保证机制临时接管学习策略。在智能体重新获得控制权时，这些中断如何影响循环策略仍存在研究空白。基准证据表明，中断使任务变量更难从循环隐藏状态中解码，并增加中断后碰撞风险。研究结果表明，改变的循环上下文通过动作-观测反馈环路延长交接后性能退化，其中改变的动作改变飞行路径和后续循环更新。为应对这一脆弱性，我们提出三种中断感知架构，分别通过独立特征流、专用中断记忆或门控环境特征，使循环处理以中断上下文为条件。在仿真中，三种架构均比标准循环策略保留更多可解码的任务信息。此外，最强架构相对于循环基线将中断后碰撞减少 74%，将中断导致的 mission failures 减少 69%，且不降低无中断性能。这些结果表明，安全中断并不保证安全交接，并支持面向韧性 UAS 自主性的中断感知循环设计。

items.title_en: A Morphing Aerial Robot With Thruster-Integrated Flexible Continuum Links for Shape Adaptive Aerial Manipulation
items.title_zh: 面向形状自适应空中操作的集成推进器柔性连续体连杆变形空中机器人
items.abstract_en: In recent years, aerial manipulation has attracted increasing attention as a key to expand the application of aerial robots. In this work, we focus on two major research directions for achieving versatile aerial manipulation: (i) acquiring high environmental adaptability using soft manipulators, and (ii) expanding the feasible wrench space by distributing thrusters along the manipulator. However, no aerial robot has simultaneously satisfied these two requirements. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a morphing rotor-distributed aerial robot with flexible continuum links that achieves both high shape adaptability and an expanded wrench space. The flexible continuum links function as soft manipulators, passively conforming to the shape of the environment, while the thrusters distributed along the continuum links expand the feasible thrust wrench space and enable the end-effector to exert large interaction forces. To realize the proposed robot, it is essential to suppress vibrations of the lightweight continuum links. Thus, we develop a composite leaf-spring structure that provides both high torsional and vertical stiffness, and vibration-suppressing control methods. Using these implementations, we demonstrate stable flight and a variety of aerial manipulation tasks. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to realize aerial manipulations using flexible links with an integrated thruster.
items.abstract_zh: 近年来，空中操作作为扩展空中机器人应用的关键受到越来越多关注。在本工作中，我们聚焦实现多功能空中操作的两个主要研究方向：（i）使用软体机械臂获得高环境适应性；（ii）通过沿机械臂分布推力器来扩展可行力旋量空间。然而，尚无空中机器人同时满足这两项要求。因此，本文提出一种具有柔性连续体连杆的变形旋翼分布式空中机器人，同时实现高形状适应性和扩展的力旋量空间。柔性连续体连杆作为软体机械臂，被动顺应环境形状；而沿连续体连杆分布的推力器扩展可行推力力旋量空间，并使末端执行器能够施加大的交互力。为实现所提出的机器人，抑制轻质连续体连杆的振动至关重要。因此，我们开发了一种同时提供高扭转刚度和垂直刚度的复合板簧结构，以及抑振控制方法。利用这些实现，我们展示了稳定飞行和各种空中操作任务。据我们所知，这是首个使用集成推力器的柔性连杆实现空中操作的工作。

items.title_en: MatchCityLoc: Aerial Localization in LoD City Models via Surface Normal Matching
items.title_zh: MatchCityLoc：通过表面法线匹配在LoD城市模型中的空中定位
items.abstract_en: Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) navigation in urban environments requires precise pose estimation. Because Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) signals are often unreliable in cities, visual localization serves as a crucial complement. Within this domain, textureless Level-of-Detail (LoD) city models provide a lightweight and privacy-preserving substitute for heavy 3D textured meshes. However, localizing against abstract geometry is challenging. Existing pipelines typically score 2D silhouette overlaps, which can suffer from severe geometric ambiguities. We present MatchCityLoc, a framework that shifts this paradigm to direct feature matching from a noisy 6-DoF pose prior. By extracting surface normals from the query image using a zero-shot foundation model and matching them against rendered LoD normals, we establish explicit 3D-to-2D correspondences. This enables a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) pose solve, which we iteratively refine through a render-and-match loop. Experiments demonstrate strong pose recall and accurate translation and rotation among the evaluated off-the-shelf LoD-based methods with very few renderings. By bridging the modality gap between aerial imagery and texture-free geometry, MatchCityLoc enables accurate localization using lightweight, privacy-preserving city models.
items.abstract_zh: 无人机（UAV）在城市环境中的自主导航需要精确的位姿估计。由于城市中 GNSS 信号常常不可靠，视觉定位成为关键补充。在这一领域，无纹理的细节层次（LoD）城市模型为体积庞大的三维纹理网格提供了一种轻量且保护隐私的替代方案。然而，基于抽象几何进行定位颇具挑战：现有流程通常对二维轮廓重叠度打分，容易受严重几何歧义影响。我们提出 MatchCityLoc，将该范式转为从带噪声的六自由度先验位姿出发做直接特征匹配。方法利用零样本基础模型从查询图像中提取表面法线，并与渲染出的 LoD 法线匹配，从而建立显式的 3D–2D 对应关系，进而求解 PnP 位姿，并通过“渲染—匹配”循环迭代优化。实验表明，在所评估的现成 LoD 方法中，该方法以极少的渲染次数取得了较高的位姿召回率以及准确的平移与旋转估计。通过弥合航空影像与无纹理几何之间的模态鸿沟，MatchCityLoc 使得利用轻量、保护隐私的城市模型进行精确定位成为可能。
items.highlight_zh: 用表面法线匹配打通航拍图与无纹理 LoD 模型定位
items.digest_zh:
这篇论文解决的是城市里无人机“我在哪”的问题。卫星导航（GNSS）在高楼林立的城区经常失准，因此需要靠视觉来补位。理想的城市三维地图是带纹理的精细网格，但这类数据体积巨大，还涉及隐私，不便于机载使用。作者转而使用细节层次（LoD）城市模型——只有几何体块、没有纹理的“积木式”城市，轻量且不泄露真实影像。

问题在于：对着这样抽象的几何体做定位很难。以往方法多是比较图像轮廓与渲染轮廓的重叠程度，而城市中形状相似的楼体很多，轮廓容易混淆。

方法与创新：MatchCityLoc 换了个思路，不再比轮廓，而是比“表面朝向”。它用零样本基础模型从无人机拍摄的查询图像中估计出表面法线，再与渲染出来的 LoD 模型法线做匹配，由此得到明确的 3D–2D 对应点对；有了对应关系，就能用 PnP 算法解出相机位姿，并通过“渲染—匹配”的迭代循环不断精化。起始位姿来自一个带噪声的六自由度先验。

结果：在与现有基于 LoD 的方法对比中，该方法位姿召回率高、平移与旋转估计准确，而且所需渲染次数很少，计算开销小。

为何重要：它把航拍影像与无纹理几何这两种差异很大的数据“对齐”了起来，说明无需昂贵的带纹理三维地图，仅靠轻量且保护隐私的城市模型就能实现精确的空中定位，这对城市无人机导航的实际部署具有直接价值。

items.title_en: Borrowed Eyes: Markerless Nano-UAV Flight with an Active Quadruped Observer
items.title_zh: 借来的眼睛：与主动四足观察者协同的无标记纳米无人机飞行
items.abstract_en: Nano unmanned aerial vehicles (nano-UAVs) can navigate confined spaces that larger robots cannot, but their payload capacity severely limits the sensors and compute available for self-localization in global navigation satellite system (GNSS)-denied environments. We present a vision-based system that localizes a nano-UAV from a quadruped robot with an arm-mounted camera. The quadruped tracks the drone, estimates its position in its own coordinate system using segmentation masks and depth, and transmits that position over a real-time radio link. To ensure continuous tracking, we developed a perception-aware nonlinear Model Predictive Controller (NMPC) that dynamically adjusts the quadruped's body and arm to maximize the drone's visibility, treating observation reliability as a primary control objective. Relying solely on this external estimate, the nano-UAV executed predefined trajectories from takeoff to landing with a median 3D localization error of 59 mm. The system demonstrates robustness against short visual occlusions by smoothly transitioning to onboard inertial flight when line-of-sight is temporarily lost. Ultimately, this framework allows a quadruped to offload the localization burden of a nano-UAV, enabling inspection of complex spaces that neither robot could navigate alone.
items.abstract_zh: 纳米无人机（nano-UAV）可以导航大型机器人无法进入的受限空间，但其载荷能力严重限制了在 GNSS 拒止环境中用于自定位的传感器和计算资源。我们提出一种基于视觉的系统，利用配备臂载相机的四足机器人对纳米无人机进行定位。四足机器人跟踪无人机，使用分割掩码和深度估计其在自身坐标系中的位置，并通过实时无线电链路传输该位置。为确保连续跟踪，我们开发了一种感知感知的非线性模型预测控制器（NMPC），动态调整四足机器人的身体和机械臂以最大化无人机可见性，将观测可靠性作为主要控制目标。仅依靠这种外部估计，纳米无人机执行了从起飞到着陆的预定义轨迹，三维定位误差中位数为 59 mm。该系统通过在线路视距暂时丢失时平滑过渡到机载惯性飞行，展示了对短时视觉遮挡的鲁棒性。最终，该框架使四足机器人能够卸载纳米无人机的定位负担，从而实现对任一机器人单独无法导航的复杂空间进行检查。

items.title_en: Bio-inspired Thrust-Assisted Trotting on a legged-Aerial Robot via Real-Time QP-MPC
items.title_zh: 基于实时QP-MPC的仿生推力辅助腿足-空中机器人小跑运动
items.abstract_en: This paper presents the hardware implementation of a quadratic program-based controller on Harpy: thruster-assisted bipedal robot to perform thruster-assisted trotting. This is inspired by wing-assisted locomotion observed in birds such as the chukar partridge, which employ thrust vectoring to manipulate the ground reaction force. The proposed controller formulates the thruster-assisted spring-loaded inverted pendulum dynamics as a condensed QP-based model predictive control problem, enabling simultaneous regulation of ground contact force and active thrust vectoring at 500 Hz. A decoupled control architecture is used, where the robot's sagittal dynamics are controlled using QP-MPC while the frontal dynamics is regulated using a cascade orientation stabilization controller. Two experiments were conducted with different forward reference velocities of 0 m/s and 0.1 m/s. While the instantaneous velocity oscillates, the mean velocities can track their respective reference. Additionally, joint tracking error remains within 1 deg while tracking the desired leg length given by the leg trajectory controller and desired swing trajectory given by Raibert's heuristic. The QP-MPC problem is consistently solved with 0.18ms, which is well within the 2ms computation budget while satisfying the GRF friction cone constraint.
items.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了在Harpy——推力辅助双足机器人——上基于二次规划的控制器硬件实现，以执行推力辅助小跑。其灵感来自石鸡等鸟类中观察到的翼辅助运动，这些鸟类利用推力矢量操纵地面反作用力。所提控制器将推力辅助弹簧负载倒立摆动力学表述为紧凑的基于QP的模型预测控制问题，能够在500 Hz下同时调节地面接触力和主动推力矢量。采用解耦控制架构，机器人矢状面动力学由QP-MPC控制，而额状面动力学由级联姿态稳定控制器调节。以0 m/s和0.1 m/s的不同前向参考速度进行了两组实验。尽管瞬时速度发生振荡，平均速度能够跟踪各自的参考值。此外，在跟踪腿部轨迹控制器给出的期望腿长和Raibert启发式给出的期望摆动轨迹时，关节跟踪误差保持在1 deg以内。QP-MPC问题以0.18ms一致求解，充分处于2ms计算预算内，同时满足GRF摩擦锥约束。

items.title_en: Shared-Control Teleoperation of Omnidirectional Aerial Robots for Continuous Valve Rotation
items.title_zh: 面向连续阀门旋转的全向空中机器人共享控制遥操作
items.abstract_en: Omnidirectional aerial robots offer full 6-DoF independent control over position and orientation, making them popular for aerial manipulation. Although there have been advancements in robotic autonomy, human operation remains essential in complex aerial environments. Previously, we proposed an aerial teleoperation system that brings the rotational flexibility of human hands into the unbounded aerial workspace, which was evaluated through a vertically mounted valve-turning task. However, due to the limited range of human forearm's motion, the robot could not continuously rotate the valve, hindering its application in industry. In this work, we propose an approach to initiate continuous rotation when the forearm angle exceeds a threshold. This switch of control authority exemplifies the concept shared control from human-robot interaction, marking a further step in aerial teleoperation.
items.abstract_zh: 全向空中机器人提供位置和姿态的完整6自由度独立控制，使其在空中操作中广受欢迎。尽管机器人自主性已有进展，但在复杂空中环境中人的操作仍然必不可少。此前，我们提出了一种空中遥操作系统，将人手的旋转灵活性引入无界的空中工作空间，并通过竖直安装的阀门旋转任务进行了评估。然而，由于人前臂运动范围有限，机器人无法连续旋转阀门，阻碍了其工业应用。在这项工作中，我们提出一种当前臂角度超过阈值时启动连续旋转的方法。这种控制权的切换体现了人机交互中的共享控制概念，标志着空中遥操作又向前迈进了一步。

items.title_en: Model-Based Systems Engineering Framework for SysML-Driven Design of Autonomous UAVs
items.title_zh: 面向SysML驱动的自主无人机设计的基于模型的系统工程框架
items.abstract_en: Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are complex cyber-physical systems that require the coordinated integration of flight control, navigation, perception, communication, power management, and mission-level decision-making under safety, timing, and reliability constraints. However, many autonomous UAV development workflows still rely on document-centric requirements, separated architectural descriptions, and software implementation artifacts, which can lead to ambiguity, interface inconsistencies, and weak traceability during early design. This paper presents a Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) design framework for the SysML-driven development of autonomous UAVs. The proposed framework uses the Systems Modeling Language (SysML) as a formal design backbone to structure UAV development across four connected layers: stakeholder requirements, functional decomposition, logical architecture, and physical/software allocation. SysML requirement diagrams, activity diagrams, block definition diagrams, internal block diagrams, state machine diagrams, and parametric diagrams are used to capture the functional, structural, behavioral, interface, and performance aspects of the UAV system. The logical architecture is then systematically mapped to a Robot Operating System 2 (ROS 2) software architecture by relating SysML blocks to ROS 2 nodes, flow ports and connectors to topics, request-response interactions to services, and goal-oriented behaviors to actions. The framework is illustrated at the design level using representative autonomous UAV mission scenarios, including autonomous take-off, waypoint navigation, hover stabilization, obstacle avoidance, return-to-home, and emergency handling. The resulting model supports requirement allocation, interface definition, subsystem responsibility assignment, and verification planning before simulation or physical deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 自主无人机（UAV）是复杂的信息物理系统，需要在安全性、时序和可靠性约束下协调集成飞行控制、导航、感知、通信、电源管理和任务级决策。然而，许多自主无人机开发流程仍依赖以文档为中心的需求、分离的架构描述和软件实现制品，这可能在早期设计阶段导致歧义、接口不一致和可追溯性薄弱。本文提出一个基于模型的系统工程（MBSE）设计框架，用于SysML驱动的自主无人机开发。所提框架使用系统建模语言（SysML）作为形式化设计主干，将无人机开发组织为四个相互连接的层次：利益相关者需求、功能分解、逻辑架构以及物理/软件分配。使用SysML需求图、活动图、模块定义图、内部模块图、状态机图和参数图来捕获无人机系统的功能、结构、行为、接口和性能方面。随后，通过将SysML模块关联到ROS 2节点、将流端口和连接器关联到话题、将请求-响应交互关联到服务、将目标导向行为关联到动作，将逻辑架构系统地映射到机器人操作系统2（ROS 2）软件架构。该框架在设计层面使用具有代表性的自主无人机任务场景进行说明，包括自主起飞、航点导航、悬停稳定、避障、返航和应急处理。所得模型支持在仿真或物理部署之前进行需求分配、接口定义、子系统职责分配和验证规划。

items.title_en: DiffDreamer: Coupling World Models with Differentiable Simulation for Agile Quadrotor Control
items.title_zh: DiffDreamer：将世界模型与可微仿真耦合用于敏捷四旋翼控制
items.abstract_en: Tasks such as quadrotor dynamic-gate racing require agents to anticipate external motion while maintaining precise high-frequency control. World-model-based reinforcement learning provides a natural solution by learning latent dynamics for future imagination, yet it often entangles environmental evolution and the robot's own dynamics in a single learned rollout, where model bias can affect policy optimization efficiency. We propose DiffDreamer, a differentiable reinforcement learning framework that tightly couples a learned world model with differentiable simulation for actor optimization. In one optimization step, the learned world model propagates latent states that capture external dynamics and history-dependent features, while the differentiable simulator propagates the robot's explicit physical state. We further decompose the actor objective into a critic-driven pathway for non-differentiable task rewards and a simulator-driven pathway for differentiable motion rewards. Experiments on aggressive tracking and dynamic-gate racing show that DiffDreamer improves training convergence over the model-free, model-based, and differentiable-RL baselines, and final performance over these baselines and classical planning and control methods. Additional experiments assess reward decomposition and the odometry-conditioned relative-state representation through ablations. We also provide proof-of-concept real-world flight experiments for validation.
items.abstract_zh: 四旋翼动态门竞速等任务要求智能体在保持精确高频控制的同时预测外部运动。基于世界模型的强化学习通过学习潜在动力学进行未来想象，提供了一种自然解决方案，但它常常在单次学习rollout中将环境演化和机器人自身动力学纠缠在一起，其中模型偏差会影响策略优化效率。我们提出DiffDreamer，一种可微强化学习框架，将学习到的世界模型与可微仿真紧密结合用于actor优化。在一个优化步骤中，学习到的世界模型传播捕获外部动力学和历史相关特征的潜在状态，而可微仿真器传播机器人的显式物理状态。我们进一步将actor目标分解为用于不可微任务奖励的critic驱动通路和用于可微运动奖励的仿真器驱动通路。在激进跟踪和动态门竞速上的实验表明，DiffDreamer相比无模型、基于模型和可微强化学习基线改善了训练收敛性，并且相比这些基线以及经典规划与控制方法改善了最终性能。额外实验通过消融评估了奖励分解和以里程计为条件的相对状态表示。我们还提供了概念验证的真实世界飞行实验以进行验证。

items.title_en: RoSAMDepth: Robust Self-supervised Depth Estimation Leveraging Segment Anything Model
items.title_zh: OpenFlyV2：面向空中感知与导航的机载视觉-语言-动作模型
items.abstract_en: Robust depth estimation aims to maintain high-quality depths across diverse conditions. However, most existing methods estimate depth without taking into account the object-level information. As a result, the predicted depth may easily deviate within objects and become blurred under adverse conditions. To overcome this weakness, we propose RoSAMDepth, a novel framework that can assist robust self-supervised depth estimation in leveraging rich and diverse object-level priors from the Segment Anything Model (SAM). We focus on incorporating object-level information across three key aspects: a segment-guided representation contrasting method that injects object-level awareness into the feature representation space; an adaptive regional outlier masking strategy combined with a regional Gaussian likelihood loss that enforces regional depth smoothness; and an object-level reliability estimation strategy that mitigates the influence of unreliable supervision. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and diverse weather conditions demonstrate that our method produces sharper, more accurate depth predictions, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/xagao/RoSAMDepth.
items.abstract_zh: 人类能基于共享的感知基础去理解环境、关注被指称的实体、推理空间关系并行动。让空中机器人具备类似的功能组织仍很困难：现有系统往往为单一能力定制、依赖机下计算，或无法在资源受限平台上持续闭环运行。我们提出 OpenFlyV2，一个统一的机载视觉-语言-动作架构，用共享的视觉-语言表征在单一模型中支撑语义理解、语言定位感知、空间推理与连续飞行控制；紧凑的 action expert 将多模态上下文转换为短时程航点，运动感知的时序记忆与动作先验降低闭环执行开销。我们还构建了约 7 万条导航轨迹、6 万条视觉-语言指令—回复对的仿真数据集。OpenFlyV2 在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 上完全机载、以 10 Hz 生成每个含 12 个航点的动作块，并从仿真零样本迁移到真实四旋翼飞行，在四个真实环境中无需真实航拍训练数据即达 48% 导航成功率。
items.highlight_zh: 单一机载 VLA 模型实现零样本真机闭环飞行
items.digest_zh:
• 问题：人类用同一套感知基础完成「看懂环境、注意被指对象、推理空间关系、执行动作」，但空中机器人往往每种能力单独做一套模型，或把重计算放在机下，很难在算力受限的无人机上闭环飞行。
• 方法：OpenFlyV2 把语义理解、语言定位感知、空间推理和连续飞行控制放进一个机载视觉-语言-动作架构，共享同一视觉-语言表征；一个紧凑的 action expert 把多模态上下文转成短时程航点，再用运动感知的时序记忆与动作先验压低闭环推理开销。作者还构建了约 7 万条导航轨迹、6 万条视觉-语言指令—回复对的仿真数据集。
• 结果：在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 上完全机载运行，10 Hz 输出每块 12 个航点的动作块；从仿真零样本迁移到真实四旋翼，在四个真实场景中不用任何真实航拍训练数据，导航成功率达 48%。
• 意义：说明广泛视觉-语言能力与连续闭环飞控可以共存于一个模型，并跑在资源受限的机载平台上。

items.title_en: Onboard Lightweight LLM Reasoning for Human-Aware Safe UAV Navigation
items.title_zh: 面向人感知安全无人机导航的机载轻量级LLM推理
items.abstract_en: Aerial robots operating near people must treat a pedestrian, a parked car, and a wall differently, yet conventional perception--planning stacks reduce all of them to occupied geometry---a \emph{human-aware safety gap} in which category-specific clearance is unavailable to the planner and temporary occlusions remove pedestrian-specific constraints from its map. We present a modular, fully onboard pipeline that closes this gap by turning visual observations into context-dependent safety constraints for real-time UAV navigation. A shared BLIP encoder drives scene captioning and text-conditioned segmentation, which is fused with depth to localize obstacles in 3D. Obstacle-specific risk is inferred by a lightweight LLM (Qwen-2.5-0.5B) stabilized with retrieval-augmented generation and grammar-constrained decoding that restricts its output to a planner-compatible JSON schema. The LLM reasons once per object category rather than per frame: its verdicts are cached per class, so previously seen categories are resolved without inference and new ones trigger a fresh retrieval-grounded query; detections are additionally given persistent identities and held in the map across occlusions. The perception pipeline runs at 10\,Hz on a Jetson Orin NX, while fallback LLM queries take approximately 0.8\,s and remain off the control-critical path. In Gazebo, low-altitude urban navigation among pedestrians and vehicles shows a roughly $3\times$ reduction in collision events over a geometric planner, and semantics-aware landing among moving actors raises success from 34\% to 96\%. The 224-pixel encoder input limits reliable small-object perception at range; conservative pedestrian margins and short-term persistence mitigate this limitation during navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 在人群附近作业的无人机需要区别对待行人、停放车辆与墙壁，但传统感知—规划流水线把它们一律简化为占据几何，形成“人类感知安全鸿沟”：规划器拿不到与类别相关的安全间距，临时遮挡还会让行人的专属约束从地图中消失。本文提出一条模块化、完全机载的流水线：共享 BLIP 编码器驱动场景描述与文本条件分割，再与深度图融合实现障碍物三维定位；障碍物风险由轻量级 LLM（Qwen-2.5-0.5B）推断，并用检索增强生成与语法约束解码稳定输出，使其只产生规划器兼容的 JSON。LLM 按物体类别而非逐帧推理，结果按类缓存，检测目标具有持久身份以跨越遮挡。在 Gazebo 城市低空导航中，碰撞事件较几何规划器减少约 3 倍，语义感知着陆成功率由 34% 提升至 96%。编码器 224 像素输入限制了远距离小目标感知。
items.highlight_zh: 类别级缓存 LLM 语义约束，碰撞事件减少约 3 倍
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究了什么问题：无人机在人群附近飞行时，必须对行人、汽车、墙给出不同的安全间距，但常规方法把所有障碍都当成“占地方的一块几何”，规划器无法按类别设定安全边界；而且行人被临时遮挡后，其专属约束还会从地图上消失。
2) 用了什么方法：作者搭建一条完全运行在机载设备上的模块化流水线。用共享的 BLIP 编码器同时完成场景描述和“文本条件分割”，再与深度图融合，把障碍物定位到三维空间。风险判断交给轻量级 LLM（Qwen-2.5-0.5B），并用检索增强生成（RAG）加语法约束解码，强制输出规划器能直接读取的 JSON 格式。关键效率设计是“按类别推理”，不按帧推理：同一类物体只询问一次 LLM，结果缓存复用；新类别才触发新的检索查询。检测到的物体还获得持久身份，被遮挡时仍保留在地图中。
3) 有什么结果：整套感知在 Jetson Orin NX 上以 10 Hz 运行，LLM 兜底查询约 0.8 秒，且不在控制关键路径上，因此不会拖慢实时控制。Gazebo 中行人车辆混行的城市低空场景里，碰撞事件比纯几何规划器减少约 3 倍；在移动目标间进行语义感知着陆，成功率从 34% 提升到 96%。
4) 为何重要：它把“物体是什么、该离多远”这类语义安全约束变成了机载实时可用的东西，而不是依赖云端大模型。作者也如实说明局限：224 像素输入在远距离小目标上不可靠，只能靠保守的行人安全裕度和短时记忆来缓解。

items.title_zh: 面向野火响应中无人机自主探索的多智能体强化学习
items.abstract_en: This study develops a deep reinforcement learning framework for training Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) agents to navigate and monitor simulated wildfire environments. Results show that agents learn increasingly stable and effective behaviors over time, as demonstrated by converging loss trends, improved reward signals, and more consistent navigation patterns such as fire-boundary tracking. Overall, these findings highlight the potential of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based UAV systems for autonomous wildfire monitoring and suggest that environmental structure and reward design influence policy effectiveness.
items.abstract_zh: 本研究开发了一个深度强化学习框架，用于训练无人机（UAV）智能体在模拟野火环境中导航和监测。结果表明，智能体随时间学习到越来越稳定和有效的行为，表现为损失趋势收敛、奖励信号改善以及诸如火边界跟踪等更一致的导航模式。总体而言，这些发现凸显了基于深度强化学习（DRL）的无人机系统在自主野火监测方面的潜力，并表明环境结构和奖励设计会影响策略有效性。

items.title_en: DuctAM: A Duct-Assisted Quadrotor-Based Aerial Manipulator Enabling High-Force Push-and-Pull Interactions
items.title_zh: DuctAM：一种导管辅助的基于四旋翼的空中机械臂，实现高力推拉交互
items.abstract_en: Uncrewed Aerial Manipulators (UAMs) extend the capabilities of Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) from perception to physical interaction. Among various aerial interactions, push-and-pull operations are fundamental manipulation primitives that require sustained horizontal forces while maintaining stable flight. In this paper, we propose DuctAM, a compact aerial manipulation platform that enhances horizontal force capability for push-and-pull interactions using two ducted fans integrated along the quadrotor interaction axis. An attitude-force decoupled control scheme enables controllable horizontal forces without requiring large attitude changes. Extensive real-world experiments are conducted to validate the DuctAM. Figure-eight trajectory tracking experiments demonstrate stable flight and accurate motion control in both quad and duct modes. Force-measurement experiments quantify the decoupled longitudinal force capability of DuctAM. Finally, representative push-and-pull interaction tasks, including cart pushing, door closing, and drawer opening, verify the practical effectiveness of DuctAM. The results show that DuctAM achieves significantly improved horizontal interaction force capability while maintaining stable flight compared with conventional UAVs.
items.abstract_zh: 无人空中操作器（UAM）将无人飞行器（UAV）的能力从感知扩展到物理交互。在各种空中交互中，推拉操作是基本的操作原语，需要在保持稳定飞行的同时提供持续的水平力。本文提出DuctAM，一种紧凑型空中操作平台，利用沿四旋翼交互轴集成的两个涵道风扇增强推拉交互的水平力能力。姿态-力解耦控制方案无需大幅姿态变化即可实现可控水平力。进行了大量真实世界实验以验证DuctAM。8字形轨迹跟踪实验表明，在四旋翼模式和涵道模式下均具有稳定飞行和精确运动控制。测力实验量化了DuctAM的解耦纵向力能力。最后，包括推车、关门和开抽屉在内的代表性推拉交互任务验证了DuctAM的实际有效性。结果表明，与传统无人机相比，DuctAM在保持稳定飞行的同时显著提高了水平交互力能力。

items.title_en: UWB Meets Crazyflow: Simulating Degraded Feedback at Scale for Aerial Robotics
items.title_zh: UWB遇见Crazyflow：为空中机器人大规模模拟退化反馈
items.abstract_en: In this work, we introduce Crazyflow, an accurate, differentiable simulator built on JAX. By leveraging jit compilation via XLA, Crazyflow unifies physics and control into a single differentiable computation graph, enabling massive parallelization on accelerated hardware without sacrificing modeling accuracy. This architecture achieves order-of-magnitude speedups over existing baselines, capable of training deployable reinforcement learning agents in seconds. To highlight its highly modular design, we demonstrate how easily Crazyflow can be extended by integrating a complete, high-fidelity Ultra-Wideband (UWB) and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) simulation pipeline coupled with a full-state Extended Kalman Filter (EKF). This capability allows for massive parallel controller evaluation under realistic, degraded state feedback with minimal impact on GPU throughput. By combining speed, accuracy, and extensibility, Crazyflow serves as a foundational tool for the next generation of aerial robotics research.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 Crazyflow，一个基于 JAX 构建的精确、可微分仿真器。借助 XLA 的即时编译，Crazyflow 将物理与控制统一到单一可微分计算图中，从而在加速硬件上实现大规模并行而不牺牲建模精度。该架构相较现有基线取得数量级加速，可在数秒内训练出可部署的强化学习智能体。为展示其高度模块化的设计，我们集成了一套完整的高保真超宽带（UWB）与惯性测量单元（IMU）仿真流水线，并配合全状态扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）。这一能力使得在真实退化状态反馈下进行大规模并行控制器评估成为可能，且几乎不影响 GPU 吞吐。凭借速度、精度与可扩展性，Crazyflow 可作为下一代空中机器人研究的基础工具。
items.highlight_zh: JAX 可微分仿真器秒级训练无人机策略，支持大规模退化反馈评估
items.digest_zh:
① 问题：无人机强化学习需要在仿真中做海量试错，但仿真既要跑得快、又要足够准，还要能模拟真实世界中传感器退化（例如超宽带 UWB 定位丢失或含噪）时的状态估计，传统仿真器往往难以兼顾。
② 方法：作者提出 Crazyflow，一个基于 JAX 的可微分仿真器。它用 XLA 的即时编译把物理仿真与控制器放进同一张可微分计算图，从而在 GPU 等加速硬件上大规模并行，同时不牺牲建模精度。它采用高度模块化的设计，作者据此接入了一整套高保真 UWB＋IMU 仿真流水线，并配一个全状态扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）。
③ 结果：相较已有基线获得数量级加速，可在数秒内训练出可部署的强化学习智能体；加入 UWB/IMU 与 EKF 后，可以在真实退化反馈下大规模并行评估控制器，而对 GPU 吞吐影响很小。
④ 为何重要：它把「快、准、可扩展」结合在一起，让研究者能在仿真中廉价地研究定位退化等现实问题，为下一代空中机器人（尤其是依赖 UWB 室内定位的无人机）提供了基础设施级工具。

items.title_en: Local Path Planning and Obstacle Avoidance for an Omnicopter Platform
items.title_zh: Omnicopter 平台的局部路径规划与避障
items.abstract_en: Autonomous unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) increasingly operate in cluttered environments where global planners such as RRT* are not directly deployable at control rates. This paper presents a real-time local planning and obstacle avoidance module for an omnidirectional multirotor (omnicopter) by extending the Dynamic Window Approach to six degrees of freedom (6D-DWA). Our method achieves real-time feasibility through (i) local-map voxelisation, (ii) a compact sphere-based approximation of the vehicle geometry, and (iii) adaptive velocity sampling in the 6D search space. To improve reactivity to unknown obstacles, we introduce a context-aware "Agile Mode" that adjusts scoring weights online to trade-off between goal progress, clearance, and heading/facing constraints during evasive manoeuvres. We evaluate our approach in simulation across computational stress tests, dense-waypoint path tracking, and static/unknown obstacle scenarios. Our planner runs consistently within a 0.2s control loop, tracks waypoint-dense global paths with < 0.1m average cross-track error and 13deg average heading error, and avoids collisions in static environments. For unknown obstacle avoidance, Agile Mode achieves 79.3% success for an off-centre obstacle and 41.4% for a centred obstacle, highlighting both the effectiveness of adaptive weighting and remaining limitations in highly constrained geometries.
items.abstract_zh: 自主无人机（UAV）越来越多地在杂乱环境中运行，在这些环境中，RRT* 等全局规划器无法直接以控制频率部署。本文通过将动态窗口法扩展到六自由度（6D-DWA），提出了一种用于全向多旋翼（omnicopter）的实时局部规划与避障模块。我们的方法通过以下方式实现实时可行性：(i) 局部地图体素化，(ii) 基于球体的紧凑车辆几何近似，以及 (iii) 在 6D 搜索空间中的自适应速度采样。为提高对未知障碍物的反应能力，我们引入了一种上下文感知的“敏捷模式”，该模式在线调整评分权重，以在规避机动期间在目标推进、间隙和航向/朝向约束之间进行权衡。我们在仿真中评估了我们的方法，涵盖计算压力测试、密集航点路径跟踪以及静态/未知障碍物场景。我们的规划器始终在 0.2 s 的控制循环内运行，跟踪航点密集的全局路径，平均横向跟踪误差 < 0.1 m，平均航向误差 13°，并在静态环境中避免碰撞。对于未知障碍物避障，敏捷模式对偏心障碍物取得 79.3% 的成功率，对中心障碍物取得 41.4% 的成功率，这既突出了自适应加权的有效性，也突出了在高度受限几何形状中的剩余局限性。

items.title_en: HyperDrone: Simulation-to-Reality Transfer at Millions of Frames per Second
items.title_zh: HyperDrone：每秒百万帧量级的仿真到现实迁移
items.abstract_en: We present HyperDrone, an extremely fast quadrotor simulator focused on high-performance batch rendering that is more than 20x faster than existing state-of-the-art batch quadrotor simulators. HyperDrone combines highly optimized multirotor dynamics with HyperLux, a new ray-tracing engine that supports Nvidia OptiX, Vulkan, Apple Metal and WebGPU backends that takes full advantage of modern ray-tracing hardware, capable of running both components entirely on the GPU. HyperLux renders RGB, depth, semantic/instance segmentation, surface normals and optical flow observations at configurable levels of fidelity, including reflections, realistic lighting, motion blur, anti-aliasing, and Physically Based Rendering (PBR). Even in the highest-fidelity settings, HyperLux achieves millions of Frames Per Second (FPS) on consumer-grade GPUs while rendering realistic 3D scenes. We demonstrate the merits of HyperDrone by training a vision-based yaw-control policy purely in simulation and transferring it to a real small-scale quadrotor (Crazyflie) with a camera, running completely onboard.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 HyperDrone，一个极快的四旋翼仿真器，专注于高性能批量渲染，速度比现有最先进的批量四旋翼仿真器快 20 倍以上。HyperDrone 将高度优化的多旋翼动力学与全新光线追踪引擎 HyperLux 结合，后者支持 Nvidia OptiX、Vulkan、Apple Metal 与 WebGPU 后端，可充分利用现代光线追踪硬件，并使两个组件完全运行在 GPU 上。HyperLux 能渲染 RGB、深度、语义/实例分割、表面法线与光流观测，保真度可配置，包括反射、真实光照、运动模糊、抗锯齿与基于物理的渲染（PBR）。即便在最高保真度设置下，HyperLux 在消费级 GPU 上渲染逼真三维场景时仍可达数百万帧每秒。我们通过纯仿真训练一个基于视觉的偏航控制策略，并将其迁移到搭载相机的真实小型四旋翼（Crazyflie）上完全机载运行，以此验证 HyperDrone 的价值。
items.highlight_zh: 批量渲染快 20 倍，消费级 GPU 上达百万 FPS
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究了什么问题：用强化学习或模仿学习训练无人机（四旋翼）的视觉控制策略，需要在仿真里生成海量带图像的交互数据，而仿真器的渲染速度往往是最主要的瓶颈。已有能批量出图的四旋翼仿真器速度不够，限制了大规模训练和“仿真到现实”（sim-to-real）迁移的效果。
2) 用了什么方法：作者构建了 HyperDrone，把两件事都放到 GPU 上跑：一是高度优化的多旋翼飞行动力学，二是新写的光线追踪渲染引擎 HyperLux。HyperLux 支持 Nvidia OptiX、Vulkan、Apple Metal 和 WebGPU 四种后端，能吃满现代显卡的光追硬件；它能输出 RGB 图像、深度图、语义/实例分割、表面法线和光流，并可按需调节画质，包括反射、真实光照、运动模糊、抗锯齿和基于物理的渲染（PBR）。
3) 有什么结果：整体速度比现有最好的批量四旋翼仿真器快 20 倍以上；即使在最高画质下，在消费级显卡上也能达到每秒数百万帧的渲染速度，同时画面仍是逼真的三维场景。作者还做了一次完整验证：只在仿真中训练一个仅靠相机图像的偏航控制策略，然后部署到真实的 Crazyflie 小型四旋翼上，全部计算在机载完成，迁移成功。
4) 为何重要：把渲染速度推到百万帧级别，意味着同样的时间内能采样到多得多的视觉经验，使大规模、高保真的仿真训练变得实际可行，也能显著减少真机试错的风险与成本；多后端支持还让这套工具不局限于某一家硬件生态，便于社区推广。

items.title_en: MV2: Multi-View Multi-Vehicle Driving Dataset for Novel View Synthesis
items.title_zh: MV2：用于新视角合成的多视图多车辆驾驶数据集
items.abstract_en: Differentiable rendering has advanced novel view synthesis (NVS), yet applying it to real-world driving remains difficult due to sparse capture viewpoints, dynamic objects, and limited multi-trajectory data. We introduce the Multi-View Multi-Vehicle (MV2) dataset and benchmark for evaluating NVS models under large viewpoint changes in dynamic urban scenes. MV2 features synchronized captures from a car, scooter, and drone, each following distinct yet synchronized trajectories. Training NVS methods on one vehicle's camera stream and testing on another enables evaluation under substantially larger viewpoint variations than existing single-trajectory datasets. All sequences are registered via Structure-from-Motion and camera poses verified using manual pixel-level correspondence annotations, yielding 50 high-quality scenes with 12000 images. Benchmarking recent NVS and camera pose estimation methods shows that NVS performance degrades with increasing viewpoint disparity, and that feed-forward pose estimators notably lag behind optimization-based approaches, highlighting MV2 as a rigorous testbed for NVS in driving. The dataset, benchmark protocol, and project resources are available at https://mv2-dataset.github.io/.
items.abstract_zh: 可微渲染推动了新视角合成（NVS）的发展，但将其应用于真实世界驾驶仍然困难，原因包括捕获视点稀疏、动态对象以及多轨迹数据有限。我们引入了多视角多车辆（MV2）数据集和基准，用于评估动态城市场景中大视角变化下的 NVS 模型。MV2 具有来自汽车、踏板车和无人机的同步捕获，每个平台沿不同但同步的轨迹运动。在一个车辆的相机流上训练 NVS 方法并在另一个车辆上测试，可以在比现有单轨迹数据集大得多的视角变化下进行评估。所有序列均通过 Structure-from-Motion 配准，并使用人工像素级对应标注验证相机位姿，最终得到 50 个高质量场景和 12000 张图像。对近期 NVS 和相机位姿估计方法进行基准测试表明，NVS 性能随着视角差异增大而下降，并且前馈位姿估计器明显落后于基于优化的方法，这突出表明 MV2 是驾驶中 NVS 的严格测试平台。数据集、基准协议和项目资源可在 https://mv2-dataset.github.io/ 获取。

items.title_en: A Tightly Coupled Magnetic-Inertial SLAM System for Field Robots
items.title_zh: 面向野外机器人的紧耦合磁-惯性SLAM系统
items.abstract_en: Field robots operating in mines, tunnels, and disaster areas require reliable localization despite GNSS denial and degraded camera and LiDAR measurements caused by dust, smoke, or poor illumination. Missions involving both ground and aerial robots further motivate complementary sensing modalities that do not depend on visibility, preinstalled infrastructure, or wheel contact. This letter presents MISLAM, a tightly coupled magnetic-inertial simultaneous localization and mapping system using an IMU and a nine-magnetometer array, without relying on external odometry or platform-specific motion assumptions. The system combines the inertial navigation model with local polynomial magnetic-field models for short-term motion estimation and a global Gaussian process model for drift correction using an error-state Kalman filter. Offline evaluation on three indoor datasets collected with a handheld rig shows reductions in total endpoint closure error of 45.7% - 78.0% relative to magnetic-inertial odometry. Under poor illumination, MISLAM maintains tracking after visual-inertial odometry fails, achieving a horizontal closure error of 0.332 m, although vertical drift remains a limitation. These results support magnetic-inertial SLAM as a complementary localization modality for robotic sensor suites operating under degraded visual conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 在矿山、隧道和灾区运行的野外机器人，尽管存在 GNSS 拒止以及由灰尘、烟雾或不良照明导致的相机和 LiDAR 测量退化，仍需要可靠定位。涉及地面和空中机器人两者的任务进一步促使采用不依赖可见性、预装基础设施或车轮接触的互补传感模态。本文提出 MISLAM，一种使用 IMU 和九磁强计阵列的紧耦合磁惯性同时定位与建图系统，不依赖外部里程计或平台特定运动假设。该系统将惯性导航模型与局部多项式磁场模型相结合用于短期运动估计，并使用全局高斯过程模型通过误差状态卡尔曼滤波器进行漂移校正。在使用手持装置采集的三个室内数据集上的离线评估显示，相对于磁惯性里程计，总端点闭合误差降低了 45.7% - 78.0%。在不良照明下，MISLAM 在视觉惯性里程计失败后仍保持跟踪，实现 0.332 m 的水平闭合误差，尽管垂直漂移仍是一个限制。这些结果支持磁惯性 SLAM 作为一种补充定位模态，用于在退化视觉条件下运行的机器人传感器套件。

items.title_en: FAM-DQ: A Dual-Quadrotor-Based Fully Actuated Aerial Manipulator for High-Torque Interaction
items.title_zh: FAM-DQ：基于双四旋翼的全力驱动空中机械臂，用于高扭矩交互
items.abstract_en: Aerial physical interaction requires aerial manipulation platforms to generate large interaction forces and torques while maintaining precise end-effector control. However, conventional underactuated aerial manipulators suffer from strong position-attitude coupling, whereas fully actuated platform designs often face structural complexity, limited payload capacity, and insufficient torque output. This paper presents FAM-DQ, a dual-quadrotor based fully actuated aerial manipulator designed for high-torque physical interaction tasks. By mounting two quadrotor propulsion modules at the ends of a central frame through passive joints, while using a gear-driven servo to regulate the pointing direction, FAM-DQ achieves decoupled $6$-DoF end-effector control with omnidirectional manipulation capability and enhanced torque output. Experiments including trajectory tracking, attitude tracking, static torque measurement, and screw driving validate the proposed design. FAM-DQ achieves a maximum torque of $1.019~\mathrm{N}\cdot\mathrm{m}$ with a total mass of $0.447~\mathrm{kg}$, corresponding to a torque-to-mass ratio of $2.28~\mathrm{N}\cdot\mathrm{m/kg}$.
items.abstract_zh: 空中物理交互要求空中操作平台在保持精确末端执行器控制的同时产生大的交互力和力矩。然而，传统欠驱动空中机械臂存在强位置-姿态耦合，而全驱动平台设计往往面临结构复杂、有效载荷能力有限和扭矩输出不足的问题。本文提出 FAM-DQ，一种基于双四旋翼的全驱动空中机械臂，专为高扭矩物理交互任务设计。通过被动关节将两个四旋翼推进模块安装在中心框架两端，同时使用齿轮驱动伺服机构调节指向方向，FAM-DQ 实现了解耦的 6 自由度末端执行器控制，具有全向操作能力和增强的扭矩输出。包括轨迹跟踪、姿态跟踪、静态扭矩测量和螺丝拧紧在内的实验验证了所提出的设计。FAM-DQ 在总质量为 0.447 kg 时达到最大扭矩 1.019 N·m，对应扭矩质量比为 2.28 N·m/kg。

items.title_en: Learning Robot Metareasoning: Adaptive Computation Budgets for Real-Time Control
items.title_zh: 学习机器人元推理：面向实时控制的自适应计算预算
items.abstract_en: Planning while moving faces an historical trade-off between deliberation and reactivity. A planner running concurrently with execution needs time to compute, so the robot must commit to an open-loop action chunk for that duration: a longer commitment buys a better plan at the cost of feedback frequency. Existing controllers fix this action commitment, and consequently the computation budget, before deployment. However, the optimal computation time is highly state-dependent (due to factors such as unmodeled dynamics, safety constraints, and marginal optimisation gains), i.e. dynamic, therefore offline static tuning risks leaving systems blind during critical maneuvers or unable to find global effective solutions. We cast the identification of the optimal computation budget as a semi-Markov decision process (SMDP) in which a single decision defines both the robot action commitments and the time allocated to the solver. To solve this, we train a reinforcement-learning policy conditioned on the current state, the executing plan, and inexpensive planner statistics. Across ground-robot navigation, agile quadrotor flight, and contact-rich manipulation, the learned policy changes its budget with the demands of the scenario, discovering efficient reasoning patterns that outperform fixed-budget baselines. https://lorenzomagnino.github.io/learning-robot-metareasoning-review/
items.abstract_zh: 边移动边规划面临着推理与反应性之间的历史性权衡。与执行并发运行的规划器需要时间进行计算，因此机器人必须在这段时间内承诺一个开环动作块：更长的承诺以反馈频率为代价换取更好的规划。现有控制器在部署前固定这种动作承诺，从而固定计算预算。然而，最优计算时间高度依赖于状态（由于未建模动力学、安全约束和边际优化增益等因素），即动态变化，因此离线静态调参存在风险：系统可能在关键机动期间失明，或无法找到全局有效解。我们将最优计算预算的辨识表述为一个半马尔可夫决策过程（SMDP），其中单个决策同时定义机器人动作承诺和分配给求解器的时间。为解决此问题，我们训练一个强化学习策略，其条件为当前状态、正在执行的规划以及廉价的规划器统计量。在地面机器人导航、敏捷四旋翼飞行和接触丰富操作中，学习到的策略根据场景需求改变其预算，发现优于固定预算基线的有效推理模式。https://lorenzomagnino.github.io/learning-robot-metareasoning-review/

items.title_en: KinoUAV: A Benchmark for Safe and Stable UAV Vision-Language Navigation with Kinodynamic Modeling
items.title_zh: KinoUAV：面向安全稳定无人机视觉语言导航的运动动力学建模基准
items.abstract_en: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have recently emerged as important remote sensing platforms, and UAV navigation has shown great potential in remote sensing applications. However, existing methods do not explicitly incorporate kinodynamic modeling or safety distances into trajectory generation, resulting in high absolute yaw rates, frequent collisions, and low navigation success rates, which limit safety and motion stability. To address this challenge, we introduce KinoUAV, a kinodynamic benchmark comprising a dataset and KinoUAV-Agent. First, we develop a hierarchical kinodynamic trajectory generation pipeline that drives UAV through acceleration actions. It uses waypoint chains from global planning and generates trajectories segment by segment under velocity, acceleration, and jerk constraints, reducing oscillations and improving trajectory stability. Furthermore, we introduce directional free-space distance (DFD) labels into the constructed dataset to describe the available clearance for safe motion decisions. The proposed KinoUAV-Agent predicts DFDs and uses them to generate safe actions, decoupling perception from action decision-making. This design enables autonomous obstacle avoidance and improves navigation safety. The benchmark incorporates the proposed Cruise-Seek task, in which the UAV first enters the target region and then searches for the target, reducing the difficulty of target search and improving navigation success. Experiments on KinoUAV show that KinoUAV-Agent outperforms existing methods, achieving the highest success rate while maintaining lower absolute yaw rates and collision rates. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of kinodynamic modeling for safe and stable UAV navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 无人机（UAV）最近已成为重要的遥感平台，无人机导航在遥感应用中展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有方法未将运动动力学建模或安全距离显式纳入轨迹生成，导致绝对偏航率高、碰撞频繁和导航成功率低，从而限制了安全性和运动稳定性。为应对这一挑战，我们引入 KinoUAV，一个包含数据集和 KinoUAV-Agent 的运动动力学基准。首先，我们开发了一种分层运动动力学轨迹生成流水线，通过加速度动作驱动无人机。它使用来自全局规划的航点链，并在速度、加速度和加加速度约束下逐段生成轨迹，减少振荡并提高轨迹稳定性。此外，我们在构建的数据集中引入方向自由空间距离（DFD）标签，以描述安全运动决策可用的间隙。所提出的 KinoUAV-Agent 预测 DFD，并利用它们生成安全动作，将感知与动作决策解耦。该设计实现了自主避障并提高了导航安全性。该基准纳入了所提出的 Cruise-Seek 任务，其中无人机首先进入目标区域，然后搜索目标，从而降低目标搜索难度并提高导航成功率。在 KinoUAV 上的实验表明，KinoUAV-Agent 优于现有方法，在保持较低绝对偏航率和碰撞率的同时实现了最高成功率。这些结果证明了运动动力学建模对于安全稳定无人机导航的有效性。

items.title_en: Onboard Wind-Preview Model Predictive Control Using Pitot-Static Sensing for Multirotor UAVs
items.title_zh: 用于多旋翼无人机的基于皮托静压传感的机载风预览模型预测控制
items.abstract_en: Effective wind gust rejection and stable hovering are critical for the outdoor operation of autonomous drones. However, existing gust rejection methods are primarily reactive, inferring the disturbance from the resulting motion or measuring it at the airframe. Either way, the wind has already begun to act before it can be compensated. In this work, we anticipate the gust instead by measuring the wind ahead of the drone with a low-cost, low-weight pitot-static sensor mounted on a boom. The resulting wind preview is incorporated into a nonlinear model predictive controller (MPC), which optimizes the drone motion while anticipating wind disturbances. A longer boom offers more preview time but adds inertia and degrades flight performance. We characterize this trade-off in simulation and show that the optimal preview distance is not a fixed property of the platform, but shifts with the wind speed and with how quickly the drone can respond. Indoor hardware experiments confirm the trend and show that the proposed controller substantially improves hover performance against a PX4 baseline and an otherwise identical wind-unaware MPC. Outdoor experiments show that the error along the wind direction is reduced by 54 percent with respect to the baseline, demonstrating that a single wind-aligned sensor can significantly improve hovering performance.
items.abstract_zh: 有效的阵风抑制和稳定悬停对于自主无人机的户外作业至关重要。然而，现有的阵风抑制方法主要是反应式的，要么从由此产生的运动推断扰动，要么在机体上测量扰动。无论哪种方式，在能够补偿之前风已经开始作用。在本工作中，我们改为通过在无人机前方安装于支杆上的低成本、轻重量皮托-静压传感器测量风来预判阵风。由此获得的风预视被纳入非线性模型预测控制器（MPC），该控制器在预判风扰动的同时优化无人机运动。更长的支杆提供更多的预视时间，但会增加惯量并降低飞行性能。我们在仿真中刻画了这一权衡，并表明最优预视距离不是平台的固定属性，而是随风速以及无人机响应速度而变化。室内硬件实验证实了这一趋势，并表明所提出的控制器相对于PX4基线和在其他方面相同但不感知风的MPC，显著提高了悬停性能。户外实验表明，沿风向的误差相对于基线降低了54%，证明单个与风向对齐的传感器可以显著提高悬停性能。

items.title_en: TIO-Former: Ultra-Lightweight 6-Directional ToF-Inertial Odometry for Nano-UAVs via a Streaming Causal Transformer
items.title_zh: TIO-Former：基于流式因果Transformer的纳米无人机超轻量6方向ToF-惯性里程计
items.abstract_en: Autonomous nano-UAV navigation requires accurate ego-motion estimation under stringent size, weight, power, and computing (SWaP-C) constraints, where visual sensors and LiDARs exceed payload limits, optical flow degrades in low-texture scenes, and inertial-only state estimation is susceptible to accumulated drift. While multi-zone time-of-flight (ToF) arrays provide a lightweight metric complement, 6-DoF estimation from merely 384 ranges per frame is challenged by invalid returns, anisotropic observability, and temporal computational scaling. We propose TIO-FORMER, a camera-free, optical-flow-free, and mapless range-inertial odometry framework driven by an IMU and an ultra-lightweight (15 g) payload of six orthogonal 8 x 8 ToF arrays. Our frontend pairs consecutive range grids with a bilateral gated difference, while IMU-guided cross-attention dynamically routes directional features conditioned on platform kinematics. A Streaming Causal Transformer couples an uncompressed Local KV cache with compressed Chunk-FIFO memory, maintaining bounded inference cost and memory footprint independent of flight duration. In real-flight evaluations, TIO-FORMER reduces open-loop position error by 54.4% compared to nano-UAV optical flow and by 66.4%-89.1% over learned inertial baselines. We also evaluate performance across multiple environments and robustness under severe sensing degradation. Deployed on an edge RISC-V companion computer, TIO-FORMER achieves a P95 latency of 10.466 ms and peak resident memory of 6.324 MiB (less than 5 percent system RAM), demonstrating that sparse range sensing provides practical geometric anchoring for resource-constrained micro-aerial robots. Code is available at https://github.com/Ly041021/TIO-Former.
items.abstract_zh: 自主纳米无人机导航需要在严格的尺寸、重量、功耗和计算（SWaP-C）约束下进行准确的自运动估计，其中视觉传感器和LiDAR超出载荷限制，光流在低纹理场景中退化，仅惯性状态估计易受累积漂移影响。虽然多区飞行时间（ToF）阵列提供了轻量级的度量补充，但仅凭每帧384个距离值进行6自由度估计仍面临无效回波、各向异性可观测性和时间计算扩展性的挑战。我们提出TIO-FORMER，一种无相机、无光流、无地图的距离-惯性里程计框架，由IMU和六个正交8×8 ToF阵列组成的超轻量（15 g）载荷驱动。我们的前端使用双边门控差分对连续距离网格进行配对，而IMU引导的交叉注意力根据平台运动学动态路由方向特征。流式因果Transformer将未压缩的局部KV缓存与压缩的Chunk-FIFO记忆耦合，使推理成本和内存占用保持有界且与飞行时长无关。在真实飞行评估中，TIO-FORMER相比纳米无人机光流将开环位置误差降低54.4%，相比学习型惯性基线降低66.4%–89.1%。我们还评估了多种环境下的性能以及严重传感退化下的鲁棒性。部署在RISC-V边缘协处理计算机上，TIO-FORMER实现10.466 ms的P95延迟和6.324 MiB的峰值常驻内存（低于系统RAM的5%），表明稀疏距离传感为资源受限的微型空中机器人提供了实用的几何锚定。代码可在https://github.com/Ly041021/TIO-Former获取。

items.title_en: Micro Neural Policies for Safe Real-Time Robotic Control
items.title_zh: 用于安全实时机器人控制的微型神经策略
items.abstract_en: In this paper, we investigate the synthesis of Micro Neural Policies (MNP) to enable safe and robust real-time robotic control on computationally constrained embedded devices. We demonstrate that integrating Evolution Strategy (ES) and Statistical Model Checking (SMC)-based verification for policy search can drastically reduce neural network size without compromising safety and robustness. We conduct a large-scale training and evaluation of MNP on Cartpole and Quadrotor control tasks, varying control frequencies and network architectures. After validating these policies in simulation, we evaluate their deployability through zero-shot transfer to physical systems. Our experiments show that MNP can successfully achieve safe sim-to-real transfer without sacrificing control performance. We then show that the policies' memory footprint, ranging from 0.5 to 7.5 kB, allows deployment on microcontrollers, where they achieve real-time inference latency with under 25 ns of jitter while leaving the chip idle for over 97% of the time for additional workloads. This makes them a highly practical solution for severely resource-constrained robotic systems.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究微型神经策略（MNP）的合成，以在计算受限的嵌入式设备上实现安全且鲁棒的实时机器人控制。我们证明，将进化策略（ES）和基于统计模型检验（SMC）的验证集成到策略搜索中，可以大幅减小神经网络规模，同时不损害安全性和鲁棒性。我们在Cartpole和四旋翼控制任务上对MNP进行了大规模训练和评估，变化控制频率和网络架构。在仿真中验证这些策略后，我们通过零样本迁移到物理系统来评估其可部署性。实验表明，MNP能够在不牺牲控制性能的情况下成功实现安全的仿真到现实迁移。然后我们表明，策略的内存占用范围为0.5至7.5 kB，使其能够部署在微控制器上，在其中实现抖动低于25 ns的实时推理延迟，同时使芯片超过97%的时间处于空闲状态以处理额外工作负载。这使它们成为严重资源受限机器人系统的高度实用解决方案。

items.title_en: Evaluation of Monocular SLAM Systems on High-Altitude Nadir UAV Footage
items.title_zh: 高空天底无人机影像上单目SLAM系统的评估
items.abstract_en: Aerial nadir video combines weak geometric constraints with severe perceptual aliasing, making it a difficult regime for monocular SLAM. We benchmark five monocular SLAM systems on local UAV flights, synthetic city-scale imagery, and long-range aerial sequences. To isolate visual performance, we provide no inertial or GNSS aiding. Performance varies strongly with environment and trajectory scale: MASt3R-SLAM achieves the lowest mean horizontal MAE on the five DJI flights (0.53\% of reference path length), whereas no system consistently preserves global trajectory shape on the long GES and ALTO sequences. Overall, DROID-SLAM performs best, averaging 2.88\% of reference path length across completed runs. Vertical position remains poor, and large-area trajectories remain highly distorted despite loop-closure capability. Current monocular SLAM methods are by themselves therefore insufficient for reliable visual-only aerial navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 航空正下视视频结合了弱几何约束与严重的感知混叠，使其成为单目SLAM的困难场景。我们在本地无人机飞行、合成城市尺度影像和远程航空序列上对五个单目SLAM系统进行了基准测试。为隔离视觉性能，我们不提供惯性或GNSS辅助。性能随环境和轨迹尺度变化强烈：MASt3R-SLAM在五次DJI飞行上取得最低平均水平MAE（参考路径长度的0.53%），而在长GES和ALTO序列上，没有任何系统能一致地保持全局轨迹形状。总体而言，DROID-SLAM表现最佳，在完成的运行中平均为参考路径长度的2.88%。垂直位置仍然较差，且尽管具备回环检测能力，大面积轨迹仍然高度失真。因此，当前的单目SLAM方法本身不足以用于可靠的纯视觉航空导航。

items.title_en: Autonomous fixed-wing interception using reinforcement learning
items.title_zh: 基于强化学习的自主固定翼拦截
items.abstract_en: Medium altitude, long endurance unmanned aerial systems such as Shahed-type strike drones are an unanswered threat in modern conflicts. Conventional air defense systems are too expensive to provide a feasible large-scale solution. Quadcopter interceptors are a cheap, battle-proven alternative, but their extremely limited flight time restricts them to low altitude targets at short range, whereas fixed-wing platforms have the endurance to reach higher altitude targets from longer distances. However, such interceptors are still operated manually. Recent developments in learning-based controllers show potential for automation. In this work, a fixed-wing interceptor is presented that is controlled by a neural network that maps filtered monocular vision observations directly to actuator commands. The policy was trained in a custom Python environment using reinforcement learning and proximal policy optimization. The policy was then deployed on a fixed-wing platform and tested in real interception scenarios. As a baseline, two classical guidance controllers were also developed and tested in simulation. The policy is able to intercept targets both in simulation and in real flight. In simulation, the policy outperforms the classical controllers under most conditions. The interceptor was ultimately successfully validated in real flight by intercepting maneuvering fixed-wing targets. This novel system shows the potential of artificial intelligence for autonomous control of fixed-wing interceptor drones.
items.abstract_zh: 中空长航时无人机系统（如Shahed型攻击无人机）是现代冲突中尚未解决的威胁。传统防空系统过于昂贵，无法提供可行的大规模解决方案。四旋翼拦截器是一种廉价且经过实战验证的替代方案，但其极其有限的飞行时间将其限制在短距离的低空目标，而固定翼平台具有续航能力，可从更远距离到达更高高度目标。然而，此类拦截器仍由人工操作。基于学习的控制器的最新发展显示出自动化潜力。在本工作中，提出了一种固定翼拦截器，由神经网络控制，该网络将滤波后的单目视觉观测直接映射为执行器指令。该策略在自定义Python环境中使用强化学习和近端策略优化（PPO）训练。随后，该策略部署在固定翼平台上，并在真实拦截场景中测试。作为基线，我们还开发了两个经典制导控制器并在仿真中测试。该策略能够在仿真和真实飞行中拦截目标。在仿真中，该策略在大多数条件下优于经典控制器。该拦截器最终通过拦截机动固定翼目标在真实飞行中得到成功验证。这一新颖系统展示了人工智能在固定翼拦截无人机自主控制方面的潜力。

items.title_en: Optimal Path Planning with Localization constraints
items.title_zh: 带定位约束的最优路径规划
items.abstract_en: This paper studies UAV path planning in areas where GPS signals are not present. Because these drones can easily get lost when they don't have GPS, they must rely on dead reckoning and occasionally pass near cellular towers, which act as landmarks to reset and fix their position. The goal is to find the shortest path from a start to a goal location while keeping the estimation uncertainty within a given bound. To solve this problem, we propose a localization-constrained A* planner that treats uncertainty as a hard constraint during search. The robot state and covariance are propagated using an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF), and only paths that satisfy the covariance limit are considered. We also show that the proposed method does not affect heuristic used in A* and remains admissible and consistent, ensuring optimality among all feasible paths. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations and PyBullet quadrotor test show that the proposed method finds shorter and more reliable paths compared to RRT* and PRM, while always satisfying the uncertainty constraint.
items.abstract_zh: 本文研究在不存在GPS信号的区域中的无人机路径规划。由于这些无人机在没有GPS时容易迷路，它们必须依赖航位推算，并偶尔经过蜂窝基站附近，这些基站作为地标来重置和修正其位置。目标是在将估计不确定性保持在给定范围内的同时，找到从起点到终点的最短路径。为解决该问题，我们提出一种定位约束A*规划器，在搜索过程中将不确定性视为硬约束。机器人状态和协方差使用扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）传播，并且只考虑满足协方差限制的路径。我们还表明，所提出的方法不影响A*中使用的启发式函数，并保持其可采纳性和一致性，从而确保在所有可行路径中的最优性。大量蒙特卡洛仿真和PyBullet四旋翼测试表明，与RRT*和PRM相比，所提出的方法能找到更短且更可靠的路径，同时始终满足不确定性约束。

items.title_en: DROID-SLAM in the Wild
items.title_zh: DROID-SLAM在野外
items.abstract_en: We present a robust, real-time RGB SLAM system that handles dynamic environments by leveraging differentiable Uncertainty-aware Bundle Adjustment. Traditional SLAM methods typically assume static scenes, leading to tracking failures in the presence of motion. Recent dynamic SLAM approaches attempt to address this challenge using predefined dynamic priors or uncertainty-aware mapping, but they remain limited when confronted with unknown dynamic objects or highly cluttered scenes where geometric mapping becomes unreliable. In contrast, our method estimates per-pixel uncertainty by exploiting multi-view visual feature inconsistency, enabling robust tracking and reconstruction even in real-world environments. The proposed system achieves state-of-the-art camera poses and scene geometry in cluttered dynamic scenarios while running in real time at around 10 FPS. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/MoyangLi00/DROID-W.git.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个鲁棒的实时 RGB SLAM 系统，通过利用可微的不确定性感知光束法平差（Uncertainty-aware Bundle Adjustment）来处理动态环境。传统 SLAM 方法通常假设场景是静态的，因此在存在运动时会导致跟踪失败。近期的动态 SLAM 方法尝试使用预定义的动态先验或不确定性感知建图来应对这一挑战，但在面对未知动态物体或几何建图变得不可靠的高度杂乱场景时仍然受限。相比之下，我们的方法利用多视角视觉特征不一致性来估计逐像素不确定性，从而即使在真实环境中也能实现鲁棒的跟踪与重建。所提出的系统在杂乱的动态场景中实现了最先进的相机位姿和场景几何，同时以约 10 FPS 实时运行。代码和数据集见 https://github.com/MoyangLi00/DROID-W.git。

items.title_en: iMED: A Multi-Endoscope Dataset for Surgical 3D Perception
items.title_zh: iMED：用于手术3D感知的多内窥镜数据集
items.abstract_en: We introduce iMED, the first synchronized multi-endoscope dataset for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS), designed to address a fundamental limitation in surgical vision benchmarking: the absence of independent held-out viewpoints. Existing surgical datasets capture single-trajectory sequences from a single endoscope, making it impossible to distinguish geometric generalization from photometric interpolation along a narrow forward-facing path. iMED provides 340 sequences ~170K synchronized timepoints with 4 views per timepoint) recorded simultaneously from two independent stereo endoscopes across ex vivo, postmortem, and live surgical settings, spanning 14 specimens with diverse anatomical regions and motion regimes. The dataset includes calibrated camera intrinsics, ArUco-based frame-wise pose estimates with uncertainty quantification, instrument segmentation masks, and rich clinical metadata. Using a train-on-one-endoscope, test-on-another evaluation protocol, we benchmark 23 state-of-the-art methods across rigid and deformable novel view synthesis, pose estimation, feature matching, and monocular depth estimation. Our experiments show that methods relying primarily on photometric supervision degrade substantially under this held-out-endoscope setting, while methods with explicit geometric regularization are more robust across views in our benchmark. Notably, large-scale foundation models transfer surprisingly well to surgical imagery, often outperforming domain-specific models, suggesting pitfalls in current fine-tuning protocols. iMED establishes a new evaluation protocol for geometric generalization in surgical vision.
items.abstract_zh: 该文提出 iMED，首个面向机器人辅助微创手术的同步多内窥镜数据集，解决手术视觉基准缺乏独立留出视角的问题。现有数据多为单镜单轨迹，难区分几何泛化与光度插值。iMED 含340段序列、约17万同步时刻（每时刻4视角），由两个立体内窥镜在离体、尸检和活体场景采集，覆盖14标本；提供标定内参、带不确定度的ArUco位姿、器械掩码和临床元数据。采用一镜训练、另一镜测试协议，评测23种方法。依赖光度监督的方法显著退化，显式几何正则更稳健；大规模基础模型迁移良好，常优于领域专用模型。
items.highlight_zh: 首个多内窥镜同步手术数据集，揭示留出视角几何泛化差距
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：手术视觉里要判断一个3D感知算法是真懂几何，还是只在一条熟悉轨迹上做图像插值，需要“独立留出视角”。但现有手术数据集基本由单个内窥镜沿一条轨迹拍摄，训练和测试视角高度相关，难以检验跨视角几何泛化。方法：作者构建 iMED，用两个独立立体内窥镜在同一场景同步拍摄，形成每时刻4视角的数据；覆盖离体、尸检和活体场景，共14个标本，包含340段序列、约17万同步时刻。数据附带相机内参标定、基于ArUco的逐帧位姿及不确定度、器械分割掩码和临床元数据。评测采用“一镜训练、另一镜测试”协议，对23种先进方法在刚性/形变新视角合成、位姿估计、特征匹配和单目深度估计上做基准。结果：主要依赖光度监督的方法在留出内窥镜下明显掉点，而有显式几何正则的方法更稳健；大规模基础模型迁移到手术图像上表现意外地好，常超过领域专用模型，暴露出现有微调流程可能存在的问题。意义：iMED 提供了首个多内窥镜同步手术3D感知基准和更严格的几何泛化评测协议，提醒社区不要被同一轨迹上的高指标误导，也为手术视觉基础模型的选择与微调提供了新参照。
