items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Prompt-Anchored Vision-Text Distillation for Lifelong Person
items.title_en: Prompt-Anchored Vision-Text Distillation for Lifelong Person Re-identification
items.title_zh: 面向终身行人重识别的提示锚定视觉-文本蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Lifelong person re-identification (LReID) aims to train a generalizable model with sequentially collected data. However, such models often suffer from semantic drift, limited adaptability, and catastrophic forgetting as new domains emerge. Existing exemplar-free approaches largely rely on visual-only distillation or parameter regularization, while overlooking the potential of auxiliary modalities, such as text, to preserve semantic stability and enable incremental plasticity. We observe that the frozen text encoder in pretrained vision-language models can serve as a stable semantic anchor across domains. To decouple the roles of vision and text, we propose Prompt-Anchored vision-text Distillation (PAD), an asymmetric vision-text framework for semantic alignment and cross-domain generalization. On the textual side, we distill prompts to preserve vision-text alignment under a fixed semantic space, acting as a global semantic reference rather than a dominant learning signal. On the visual side, an EMA-based teacher with an adaptive prompt pool enables domain-wise adaptation by allocating new slots while freezing past ones. Extensive experiments show that PAD substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods across seen and unseen domains, achieving a strong balance between stability and plasticity. Project page: https://github.com/zu-zi/PAD.
items.abstract_zh: 终身行人重识别（LReID）要求用按序收集的数据训练通用模型，但新域不断出现会带来语义漂移、适应性受限与灾难性遗忘。现有免样本（exemplar-free）方法多依赖纯视觉蒸馏或参数正则化，忽视了文本等辅助模态在维持语义稳定、支持增量可塑性上的潜力。我们发现，预训练视觉-语言模型中冻结的文本编码器可作为跨域稳定的语义锚点。为此提出提示锚定视觉-文本蒸馏（PAD）：一个非对称的视觉-文本框架。文本侧通过提示蒸馏在固定语义空间中保持视觉-文本对齐，充当全局语义参考而非主导学习信号；视觉侧采用带自适应提示池的EMA教师，为新域分配新槽位并冻结旧槽位，实现域级适应。实验表明PAD在已见与未见域上均大幅超越现有最优方法，取得稳定性与可塑性的良好平衡。
items.highlight_zh: 冻结文本编码器可作跨域语义锚点，兼顾稳定与可塑
items.digest_zh:
1. 研究问题：终身行人重识别（LReID）要求模型一边持续接收新场景的数据，一边不忘记旧场景的知识。这天然存在一对矛盾——稳定性（不遗忘）与可塑性（能适应新域）。已有的免样本方法只靠图像蒸馏或约束参数变化，没有利用文本这类辅助信息。
2. 关键观察：在CLIP一类预训练视觉-语言模型里，文本编码器通常是冻结的，它的语义空间在不同数据集、不同摄像头域之间都保持稳定，因此可以当作一个“语义锚点”，用来稳住模型不断漂移的视觉表征。
3. 方法（PAD）：作者把视觉和文本的角色解耦，做成非对称结构。文本侧固定不动，只蒸馏一个可学习的提示（prompt），让视觉特征始终对齐到固定的文本语义空间，起全局参考作用，而不是让文本主导学习。视觉侧则用带自适应提示池的EMA教师：每遇到一个新域就新增一个提示槽位，旧槽位冻结不变，从而逐个域地积累知识、防止遗忘。
4. 结果：在已见域和未见域上，PAD都明显优于当时的SOTA方法，稳定性和可塑性之间的权衡更好，作者还开源了代码。
5. 为何重要：它给出一个简单思路——视觉-语言模型里“冻住的文本分支”是一种廉价而稳定的正则化来源。对任何需要持续学习、又拿不到旧数据的场景（安防、零售、机器人视觉）都有借鉴价值。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:An Efficient Token Compression Framework for Visual Object T
items.title_en: An Efficient Token Compression Framework for Visual Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 面向视觉目标跟踪的高效令牌压缩框架
items.abstract_en: Refining visual representations by eliminating their internal feature-level redundancy is crucial for simultaneously optimizing the performance and computational cost of models in visual tracking. To enhance their performance, many contemporary Transformer-based trackers leverage a larger number of historical template frames to capture richer spatio-temporal cues. However, this strategy leads to a massive number of input visual tokens. This creates two critical issues: it imposes a quadratic computational burden and can also degrade the tracker's overall performance. To bridge this gap, we propose a compress-then-interact tracking framework, ETCTrack, that learns to efficiently compress template tokens from historical template frames into a robust target representation, moving beyond handcrafted rules. Our method first employs the Adaptive Token Compressor to dynamically construct compact yet highly discriminative template tokens by filtering out redundant visual tokens. These refined template tokens are then processed by our Hierarchical Interaction Encoder to achieve a deep, adaptive interaction with the search features. Refined search features ensure subsequent precise target localization. Experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms current state-of-the-art trackers. ETCTrack-B224 reduces the number of template tokens by 60%, leading to a 21.4% reduction in MACs with only a 0.4% drop in accuracy. The source code are available at https://github.com/PJD-WJ/ETCTrack.
items.abstract_zh: 通过消除视觉表示内部的特征级冗余来精炼视觉表示，对于同时优化视觉跟踪模型的性能和计算成本至关重要。为提升性能，许多当代基于Transformer的跟踪器利用更多历史模板帧来捕获更丰富的时空线索。然而，该策略导致输入视觉令牌数量巨大。这带来两个关键问题：造成二次方计算负担，并且还可能降低跟踪器的整体性能。为弥补这一差距，我们提出一种“先压缩后交互”的跟踪框架ETCTrack，其学习将来自历史模板帧的模板令牌高效压缩为稳健的目标表示，超越手工设计的规则。我们的方法首先采用自适应令牌压缩器（Adaptive Token Compressor），通过滤除冗余视觉令牌来动态构建紧凑但高度判别性的模板令牌。这些精炼后的模板令牌随后由我们的分层交互编码器（Hierarchical Interaction Encoder）处理，以与搜索特征实现深度、自适应的交互。精炼后的搜索特征确保后续精确的目标定位。在七个基准上的实验表明，我们的方法优于当前最先进的跟踪器。ETCTrack-B224将模板令牌数量减少60%，使MACs降低21.4%，而准确率仅下降0.4%。源代码见 https://github.com/PJD-WJ/ETCTrack。

items.title_en: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
items.title_zh: 视频生成背后：来自 Kling 的多模态理解观察与洞见
items.abstract_en: Video generation has progressed from isolated clips to coherent short-form audiovisual sequences, and the bottleneck is shifting from rendering to semantic control. This report summarizes the observations and insights on multimodal understanding gained from successive generations of Kling. We argue that generation quality is the projection of multimodal understanding through the entire data--conditioning--alignment--evaluation chain, and we examine this chain module by module. Kling-MLLM, a shared multimodal foundation model that unifies image, video, audio, synchronized audio--video, and interleaved inputs, is specialized for each downstream module. Because a DiT is trained on far fewer training samples than a language model, we treat captioning as a semantic contract that maximizes description density, and extend it to reference-grounded captioning that makes reference bindings explicit. Prompt enhancement translates user intent into this caption distribution: basic PE is derived from captions of compelling videos and refined with text-level and generator-in-the-loop reinforcement learning, while agentic PE refines the story and retrieves compelling examples. We show that a reliable text encoder comes from perceptual training rather than from stronger language ability, and that candidates can be screened from text alone before end-to-end training. Reward modeling pairs a general reward model for explainable, localized critiques with a decision reward model for fast multidimensional scoring, treating perceptual bandwidth as a first-class design parameter. Finally, we review task-specific automatic evaluation, focusing on protocols that expose scoring shortcuts and help trace failures to their upstream source. We hope these lessons offer practical guidance for building the understanding stack behind controllable video generation.
items.abstract_zh: 视频生成已从孤立片段发展到连贯的短时音视频序列，瓶颈正从画面渲染转向语义控制。本报告总结了在 Kling 多代模型迭代中获得的多模态理解观察与洞见。我们认为，生成质量是多模态理解在“数据—条件控制—对齐—评测”整条链路上的投影，并逐模块加以剖析。Kling-MLLM 是一个共享的多模态基础模型，统一处理图像、视频、音频、同步音视频与交错输入，并为各下游模块做专门化。由于 DiT 的训练样本远少于语言模型，我们将字幕视为最大化描述密度的“语义契约”，并扩展为显式标注引用绑定关系的引用落地字幕。提示增强把用户意图翻译进这一字幕分布：基础 PE 由优质视频字幕派生，并通过文本级与生成器在环的强化学习精修；智能体式 PE 则润色故事并检索优质示例。我们表明可靠文本编码器来自感知训练而非更强的语言能力，并可在端到端训练前仅凭文本筛选候选。奖励建模将用于可解释、局部化点评的通用奖励模型与用于快速多维打分的决策奖励模型配对，并把感知带宽视为一等设计参数。最后回顾任务专用自动评测，聚焦能暴露打分捷径、并帮助把失败追溯到上游来源的协议。
items.highlight_zh: 提出生成质量是多模态理解在数据到评测全链路上的投影
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：视频生成正从几秒钟的孤立片段走向带声音的连贯短片，真正的瓶颈已不再是“画得像不像”，而是“能不能精确控制内容”。作者想回答：多模态理解在视频生成中到底起什么作用、卡在哪里。

方法与观点：报告以 Kling 多代模型的实践为线索，把整条链路拆成四段——数据、条件控制、对齐、评测——逐段分析，主张生成质量本质上是多模态理解能力在这条链上的“投影”。具体做法包括：用统一的 Kling-MLLM 处理图像、视频、音频、同步音视频与交错输入；把字幕当作“语义契约”，追求最大描述密度，并提出能显式表达引用关系的引用落地字幕；提示增强把用户意图翻译成这种字幕分布，基础版由优质视频字幕派生并用强化学习精修，智能体版还能改写故事、检索范例。

关键发现：可靠的文本编码器来自感知训练，而非单纯更强的语言能力；因此在昂贵的端到端训练之前，可以仅凭文本筛选候选方案。奖励建模采用“通用奖励模型做可解释的局部点评 + 决策奖励模型做快速多维打分”的双轨设计，并把感知带宽当成一等设计参数。

为何重要：它把视频生成的工程经验上升为可复用的方法论，强调语义与评测协议的重要性，为构建更可控的生成系统提供实践指南。

items.title_en: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
items.title_zh: WebHarbor：为可演化的 GUI 智能体环境对接真实网站
items.abstract_en: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. Live website evaluation suffers from changing content, access restrictions, and limited coverage of authenticated workflows, while existing synthetic environments for training often lack functional depth and visual fidelity. We propose WebHarbor, a suite of 153 executable and dockerized website environments that faithfully reconstruct the visual interfaces, content, and functional workflows of real-world web services under deterministic control. We build WebHarbor through task-driven human-agent collaboration, where environments evolve as new tasks expand their functional scope, coding agents implement the required changes, and human contributors audit visual fidelity, functional correctness, and task validity. The resulting suite comprises 3,518 tasks spanning multi-step and post-authentication workflows, where existing works often fail to cover. Beyond reliable evaluation, WebHarbor provides high-fidelity synthetic web environments for cost-efficient reinforcement learning (RL). We demonstrate that a Qwen 4B-level GUI agent trained with RL in WebHarbor generalizes to unseen tasks and performs competitively with leading open-source GUI web agents across four benchmarks. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebHarbor.
items.abstract_zh: GUI 网页智能体需要既真实可交互、又在评测与训练期间保持稳定的环境。对真实在线网站的评测受内容变动、访问限制与需登录流程覆盖不足之困；而现有用于训练的合成环境往往缺乏功能深度与视觉保真度。我们提出 WebHarbor，一套包含 153 个可执行、容器化（dockerized）的网站环境，可在确定性控制下忠实重建真实网络服务的视觉界面、内容与功能流程。WebHarbor 通过任务驱动的人机协作构建：新任务扩展环境的功能范围，编码智能体实现所需改动，人类贡献者审核视觉保真度、功能正确性与任务有效性。最终套件包含 3,518 个任务，涵盖多步与登录后流程等现有工作常难以覆盖的场景。除可靠评测外，WebHarbor 还提供高保真合成网页环境用于低成本强化学习（RL）。我们展示，在 WebHarbor 中用 RL 训练的 Qwen 4B 级 GUI 智能体可泛化到未见任务，并在四个基准上与领先的开源 GUI 网页智能体表现相当。代码与数据已公开。
items.highlight_zh: 153 个容器化真实网站环境与 3518 个任务，支撑可复现训练与评测
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：训练网页 GUI 智能体需要真实、可交互、又不会“变来变去”的环境。直接拿真实网站来测，会遇到内容天天更新、访问受限、需要登录的流程覆盖不到等问题；而现成的合成环境又往往功能太浅、界面不够真，智能体学到的东西难以迁移。

方法：作者提出 WebHarbor，把真实网络服务重建为 153 个可执行、容器化的网站环境，界面、内容与功能流程都尽量忠实还原，并且完全在确定性控制之下，随时可复现。构建方式是“任务驱动的人机协作”：新任务不断扩展环境需要支持的功能，由编码智能体负责实现改动，人类贡献者则审核视觉保真度、功能正确性和任务本身是否合理。这样环境能随任务演化而成长。

结果：套件共包含 3,518 个任务，覆盖多步骤操作与登录后才能完成的流程——这恰是现有工作常覆盖不到的部分。除评测外，这些高保真环境还能低成本用于强化学习：一个 Qwen 4B 级别的 GUI 智能体在其中用 RL 训练后，能泛化到没见过的任务，并在四个基准上与领先的开源 GUI 网页智能体表现相当。

为何重要：它同时解决了“评测不可复现”和“训练环境不够真”两个痛点，并公开代码与数据，为 GUI 智能体研究提供了一个可共享、可持续扩展的基础设施。

items.title_en: How Finely Can Vision-Language Models See Biology? Bio-VQA: A Benchmark for Taxonomic, Morphological, Spatial and Individual Reasoning
items.title_zh: 视觉语言模型能多精细地看懂生物学？Bio-VQA：面向分类学、形态学、空间与个体推理的基准
items.abstract_en: In biodiversity monitoring, a single image raises several questions: which taxon, how many, which trait, and whether the individual has been seen before. Vision-language models (VLMs) could answer all of these from the image, but their ability is largely untested in biology, as existing benchmarks focus mostly on species identification within a few taxonomic groups. We present Bio-VQA, the largest biological visual question answering (VQA) benchmark and the only one to span four aspects of biological visual understanding: hierarchical taxonomic reasoning, fine-grained attribute grounding, quantitative spatial reasoning, and individual re-identification. Bio-VQA contains 1.86M questions over 217K images from 11 public datasets, and extends right-or-wrong scoring to graded scoring, so a near-miss counts for more than a distant one. Evaluating 18 open-weight models from 3.75B to 38.4B parameters, we find that general visual capabilities do not transfer to biological organisms: the best model counts animals exactly on 41.7% of images with 2 to 10 individuals, less than half its accuracy on everyday objects at the same counts. Taxonomic accuracy falls to one sixth, from 0.72 at phylum to 0.12 at scientific name, and scaling helps mostly at coarse ranks. The gap to a domain specialist widens accordingly, from 0.731 against BioCLIP-2's 0.874 at class (1.2x) to 0.269 against 0.544 at scientific name (2x). On trait size measurement, 15 of the 18 models do no better than an image-blind baseline that predicts one fixed number for every specimen, and on re-identification, 17 of the 18 models fall below chance under adversarial conditions. These failures persist across a tenfold range of model size. We hope Bio-VQA becomes a standard test of how well VLM capabilities transfer to the biological domain.
items.abstract_zh: 在生物多样性监测中，单张图像会引发若干问题：属于哪个类群、有多少个、具有哪个性状，以及该个体此前是否被见过。视觉语言模型（VLM）可以从图像中回答所有这些问题，但其能力在生物学中很大程度上尚未得到检验，因为现有基准主要集中于少数分类群内的物种识别。我们提出Bio-VQA，这是最大的生物视觉问答（VQA）基准，也是唯一涵盖生物视觉理解四个方面的基准：层级分类学推理、细粒度属性定位、定量空间推理和个体重识别。Bio-VQA包含来自11个公开数据集的21.7万张图像上的186万个问题，并将对错评分扩展为分级评分，因此接近正确的答案比相距较远的答案得分更高。评估18个参数规模从3.75B到38.4B的开放权重模型后，我们发现通用视觉能力并不能迁移到生物有机体：最佳模型在包含2至10个个体的图像上仅有41.7%能精确计数动物，不到其在相同数量日常物体上准确率的一半。分类学准确率降至六分之一，从门水平的0.72降至学名水平的0.12，而规模扩展主要在粗粒度层级上有帮助。与领域专家之间的差距相应扩大，在纲水平上为0.731对BioCLIP-2的0.874（1.2倍），在学名水平上为0.269对0.544（2倍）。在性状大小测量方面，18个模型中有15个不优于一个对每个样本都预测同一固定数值的“图像盲”基线；在重识别方面，18个模型中有17个在对抗条件下低于随机水平。这些失败在模型规模十倍范围内持续存在。我们希望Bio-VQA成为检验VLM能力向生物领域迁移程度的标准测试。
items.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027, 8 pages main paper; 4 figures, 4 tables

items.title_en: Should the Action Expert Train the VLM? Action-Token Supervision and Gradient Routing in Mixture-of-Transformer VLAs
items.title_zh: 动作专家是否应训练 VLM？混合 Transformer VLA 中的动作 Token 监督与梯度路由
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly pair a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) with a flow-matching expert that conditions its action predictions on the VLM's key-value representations. Those representations must carry information useful for control, yet the VLM was never trained for the action expert's flow-matching objective. Two signals can address this: gradients backpropagated from the expert's loss (coupling), or VLM supervision to predict discrete tokens encoding the same target actions. Prominent training recipes forgo the first, blocking expert-to-VLM gradients (insulation) to protect the VLM's existing capabilities, while also supervising it on vision-language data and action tokens. Because vision-language co-training also aims to preserve those capabilities, the additional protection provided by insulation is unclear. At the same time, insulation removes a direct signal about which features continuous action prediction requires. On the other hand, action-token supervision offers an alternative way to learn action-relevant representations, which may explain why insulation succeeds in practice. We disentangle these factors in autonomous driving and manipulation by independently varying action-token supervision and whether the expert's loss updates the VLM. In open-loop driving, insulation is competitive with coupling when action tokens are supervised; without them, coupling reduces trajectory-prediction error by roughly 25%. When both components are trained jointly from the outset, coupling increases closed-loop driving route progress by approximately 17% with action-token supervision and 40% without it, and similarly improves robot manipulation performance under both settings. These findings show that the value of gradient insulation depends on the VLM's action supervision and the evaluation setting, challenging insulation as a default VLA training recipe.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型越来越多地将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）与流匹配专家配对，该专家以VLM的键值表示为条件进行动作预测。这些表示必须携带对控制有用的信息，但VLM从未针对动作专家的流匹配目标进行训练。有两种信号可以解决这一点：从专家损失反向传播的梯度（耦合），或对VLM进行监督以预测编码相同目标动作的离散令牌。主流训练方案放弃第一种，即阻断从专家到VLM的梯度（隔离），以保护VLM的现有能力，同时还在视觉-语言数据和动作令牌上对其进行监督。由于视觉-语言联合训练也旨在保留这些能力，隔离所提供的额外保护尚不明确。同时，隔离移除了关于连续动作预测需要哪些特征的一种直接信号。另一方面，动作令牌监督提供了一种学习动作相关表示的替代方式，这可能解释了隔离为何在实践中有效。我们在自动驾驶和操作任务中，通过独立改变动作令牌监督以及专家损失是否更新VLM，来解耦这些因素。在开环驾驶中，当动作令牌受到监督时，隔离与耦合具有竞争力；在没有动作令牌监督时，耦合将轨迹预测误差降低约25%。当两个组件从一开始联合训练时，在有动作令牌监督的情况下，耦合使闭环驾驶的路线进度提高约17%；在没有动作令牌监督的情况下提高40%，并在两种设置下同样改善机器人操作性能。这些发现表明，梯度隔离的价值取决于VLM的动作监督和评估设置，从而对将隔离作为默认VLA训练方案提出挑战。

items.title_en: Density-Aware Reward Scaling: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Reward-Proportional Sampling
items.title_zh: 密度感知奖励缩放：一种用于奖励比例采样的强化学习框架
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning objectives that maximize expected return can concentrate probability mass on a small subset of high-reward outcomes, limiting diversity when multiple distinct solutions are desirable. We introduce Density-Aware Reward Scaling (DARS), a simple reward-processing mechanism that promotes reward-proportional sampling in continuous outcome spaces while retaining standard policy-gradient training. DARS estimates the local density of outcomes within each on-policy rollout group and inversely scales rewards by this density. The method requires no learned density model, auxiliary objective, critic, or modification to the underlying policy-gradient objective. In a controlled multimodal navigation task, DARS-GRPO avoids the single-mode collapse exhibited by GRPO and closely recovers the target mode allocation. Applied to text-to-image prompt adaptation, DARS-GRPO consistently improves image and prompt diversity across datasets, Policy LMs, and reward settings while maintaining good semantic alignment. These results show that density-aware reward scaling provides a lightweight way to improve coverage of diverse high-reward outcomes within existing reinforcement-learning pipelines.
items.abstract_zh: 最大化期望回报的强化学习目标可能会将概率质量集中在少量高奖励结果上，从而在需要多个不同解决方案时限制多样性。我们提出密度感知奖励缩放（DARS），这是一种简单的奖励处理机制，可在连续结果空间中促进按奖励比例采样，同时保留标准策略梯度训练。DARS估计每个同策略rollout组内结果的局部密度，并按该密度对奖励进行反比缩放。该方法不需要学习到的密度模型、辅助目标、评论家，也不需要对底层策略梯度目标进行修改。在受控的多模态导航任务中，DARS-GRPO避免了GRPO表现出的单模态坍缩，并接近恢复目标模态分配。应用于文本到图像提示适配时，DARS-GRPO在跨数据集、策略语言模型（Policy LMs）和奖励设置下持续提高图像和提示的多样性，同时保持良好的语义对齐。这些结果表明，密度感知奖励缩放提供了一种轻量级方式，可在现有强化学习流程中提高对多样化高奖励结果的覆盖。

items.title_en: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Submodular Trajectory Rewards
items.title_zh: 基于子模轨迹奖励的合作多智能体强化学习
items.abstract_en: We study cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning with decoupled dynamics and a monotone submodular reward function over joint trajectories. Due to the non-additive reward, an optimal policy may depend on the history of all agents. This dependence makes exact optimization exponential in the horizon and the number of agents. To overcome this challenge while retaining theoretical guarantees, we introduce pre-window curvature $c_m$, which quantifies how states visited more than $m$ steps earlier reduce current marginal gains. Using this curvature to control the error from restricting the policy of each agent to depend only on its last $m+1$ states, we propose a greedy algorithm that exploits the decoupled dynamics to optimize local policies sequentially. For fixed $m$, the algorithm achieves a $\frac{1-c_m}{2-c_m}$ approximation guarantee up to estimation error, and its computation time is polynomial in the number of agents and the horizon. We recover the known $1/2$-factor approximation for time-additive rewards and obtain an approximation factor no smaller than the known total-curvature bound for a single agent. We formulate multi-agent traffic monitoring as an example of this framework and evaluate our algorithm on it.
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究具有解耦动力学以及关于联合轨迹的单调子模奖励函数的合作多智能体强化学习。由于奖励是非可加的，最优策略可能依赖于所有智能体的历史。这种依赖使精确优化在时域和智能体数量上呈指数级。为在保留理论保证的同时克服这一挑战，我们引入窗口前曲率 $c_m$，其量化了早于 $m$ 步以上访问的状态如何降低当前边际增益。利用该曲率来控制将每个智能体的策略限制为仅依赖其最近 $m+1$ 个状态所带来的误差，我们提出一种贪心算法，利用解耦动力学顺序优化局部策略。对于固定的 $m$，该算法在估计误差范围内达到 $\frac{1-c_m}{2-c_m}$ 的近似保证，其计算时间在智能体数量和时域上为多项式时间。对于时间可加奖励，我们恢复了已知的 $1/2$ 因子近似；并得到不小于单智能体已知总曲率界的近似因子。我们将多智能体交通监控表述为该框架的一个示例，并在其上评估我们的算法。

items.title_en: CORA: Teacher-Guided Causal O-RAN Adaptation for Jamming Detection
items.title_zh: CORA：面向干扰检测的教师引导因果O-RAN适配
items.abstract_en: In mission-critical networks, a missed jamming event is costlier than a false alarm, so detectors should favor recall, operate causally, and work without labeled attack data. Retrospective Key Performance Indicator (KPI) detectors meet the label-free requirement but rely on future context and cannot run in streaming operation. We present CORA, a teacher-guided reinforcement learning (RL) framework that transfers the hindsight of a retrospective detector to a causal one without labels during training or deployment. Offline, a retrospective KPI detector evaluated on unlabeled historical logs defines a recall-weighted reward for a masked controller that adapts the sensitivity, persistence, and grace of a causal KPI detector. At deployment, the teacher is removed and the frozen controller acts causally, with no ground-truth labels and no target-specific calibration. The design maps onto offline training in the Non-Real-Time RIC and causal control in the Near-Real-Time RIC of an Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN). Under leave-one-out transfer across ten 5G O-RAN testbed configurations, CORA reaches recall-oriented operating points on the deployable frontier that none of the evaluated baselines covers. A Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) controller raises mean recall from 0.687 to 0.771 over a fixed default detector on all ten configurations, while a Deep Q-Network (DQN) achieves a comparable F2-score to the best teacher-selected static configuration, with 61% fewer false alarms. Removing the teacher lowers recall on every configuration.
items.abstract_zh: 在任务关键型网络中，漏报干扰事件的代价高于误报，因此检测器应偏向召回率、以因果方式运行，并在没有标注攻击数据的情况下工作。回顾式关键性能指标（KPI）检测器满足无标签要求，但依赖未来上下文，无法在流式运行中工作。我们提出CORA，一种教师引导的强化学习（RL）框架，其将回顾式检测器的后见之明迁移到因果检测器，且在训练或部署期间无需标签。离线阶段，在未标注历史日志上评估的回顾式KPI检测器为一个掩码控制器定义召回加权奖励，该控制器调整因果KPI检测器的灵敏度、持续性和宽限期。部署时，教师被移除，冻结的控制器以因果方式运行，无需真实标签，也无需针对目标的校准。该设计对应开放无线接入网（O-RAN）中非实时RIC中的离线训练和近实时RIC中的因果控制。在跨十种5G O-RAN测试床配置的留一迁移下，CORA在可部署前沿上达到面向召回率的工作点，而所评估的基线均未覆盖这些工作点。在所有十种配置上，近端策略优化（PPO）控制器将平均召回率从固定默认检测器的0.687提高到0.771；而深度Q网络（DQN）达到与最佳教师选择的静态配置相当的F2分数，同时误报减少61%。移除教师会降低每种配置上的召回率。

items.title_en: ActOR: Ambient AI-Based Agentic Orchestration for Humanoid Autonomy in Operating Rooms
items.title_zh: ActOR：基于环境AI的智能体编排实现手术室中人形机器人自主性
items.abstract_en: Operating rooms (ORs) increasingly contain ambient sensing infrastructure to enable AI-based optimization of workflows and utilization. We pursue an alternative path: using ambient AI to guide robot action and optimize utilization. Deploying humanoids in the OR without ambient AI is severely limited by cumbersome de novo orientation and planning due to partial onboard observations. We posit that this can be achieved by coupling an ambient AI-based agentic orchestrator with the humanoid robotic actor, providing shared perception and execution feedback for humanoid autonomy in the OR. ActOR fuses a wall-mounted ambient camera and the robot's head-mounted camera into a shared object-level digital twin (DT). A large language model agent plans over the DT using pre-programmed locomotion and manipulation skills without task-specific training. During execution, DT updates and execution outcomes inform retries, alternative approaches, or replanning. We evaluated ActOR in simulated and physical environments. Across three tasks in two simulated ORs reconstructed from real rooms, ambient perception reduced exploration from 1.05 to 0.12 Explore calls per trial when targets were initially outside the robot's view. Closed-loop feedback increased success from 46.7% to 83.3% under nominal execution and from 8.3% to 51.7% under injected navigation, object-relocation, and grasp perturbations. In a physical mock OR with a humanoid, ActOR completed 14 of 20 single-object disposal trials and demonstrated replanning after scene changes. Ambient AI-based observations provide scene state that improves robot action planning, increasing success and reducing exploration compared with robot-only observations. Feeding skill outcomes and DT updates back to the planner improves multi-step task success. Our results show the feasibility of humanoid task autonomy for multi-step disposal tasks in a mock OR.
items.abstract_zh: 手术室（OR）中日益部署环境感知基础设施，以支持基于AI的工作流程与利用率优化。我们探索另一条路径：利用环境AI引导机器人动作并优化利用率。在没有环境AI的情况下，由于机载观测不完整，人形机器人在手术室中的部署受到繁琐的从零定向与规划的严重限制。我们提出，通过将基于环境AI的智能体编排器与人形机器人执行体耦合，为手术室中人形机器人自主性提供共享感知与执行反馈，可实现这一目标。ActOR将壁挂式环境摄像头与机器人头部摄像头融合为共享的物体级数字孪生（DT）。大语言模型智能体在DT上进行规划，使用预编程的移动与操作技能，无需任务特定训练。执行期间，DT更新与执行结果用于指导重试、替代方案或重新规划。我们在仿真和物理环境中评估ActOR。在由真实房间重建的两个仿真手术室的三项任务中，当目标最初不在机器人视野内时，环境感知将每次试验的探索调用从1.05次降至0.12次。闭环反馈在标称执行下将成功率从46.7%提高到83.3%，在注入导航、物体移位和抓取扰动下从8.3%提高到51.7%。在带有一个人形机器人的物理模拟手术室中，ActOR完成了20次单物体处置试验中的14次，并展示了场景变化后的重新规划。基于环境AI的观测提供了场景状态，改善了机器人动作规划，与仅机器人观测相比提高了成功率并减少了探索。将技能结果和DT更新反馈给规划器提高了多步任务成功率。我们的结果显示了在模拟手术室中执行多步处置任务的人形机器人任务自主性的可行性。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:SynCLIP: Synonym-Coherent Language-Image Pretraining for Rob
items.title_en: SynCLIP: Synonym-Coherent Language-Image Pretraining for Robust Open-Vocabulary Dense Perception
items.title_zh: SynCLIP：面向鲁棒开放词汇密集感知的同义词一致语言-图像预训练
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary dense perception (OVDP) aims to localize objects unseen during training by leveraging textual knowledge. Despite the remarkable progress of recent CLIP-based approaches, we identify a critical limitation: synonym-induced grounding inconsistency, where semantically equivalent expressions yield disparate spatial attention patterns. This inconsistency undermines the robustness and performance of existing methods in real-world OVDP applications. To address this issue, we propose SynCLIP, a Synonym-Coherent Language-Image Pretraining framework that enhances synonym-robust grounding for OVDP. SynCLIP introduces a Semantic-consistent Spatial Attention alignment (SSA) module to enhance spatial attention consistency by minimizing discrepancies between attention maps of original and synonymous expressions. Furthermore, a Spatial Attention Refinement (SAR) module selectively strengthens the most semantically relevant spatial regions within aligned maps for more precise and stable grounding. To support synonym-coherent pretraining, we also construct a Synonym-Enriched Visual Corpus (SEViC), which augments each category with multiple synonyms and textual definitions. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SynCLIP substantially improves grounding consistency under diverse linguistic variants and achieves state-of-the-art performance among CLIP-based OVDP methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Justlovesmile/SynCLIP.
items.abstract_zh: 开放词汇密集感知（OVDP）旨在利用文本知识定位训练时未见过的目标。尽管基于 CLIP 的方法进展显著，作者发现一个关键缺陷：同义词引起的定位不一致——语义等价的表述会产生差异明显的空间注意力模式，从而削弱现有方法在真实 OVDP 应用中的鲁棒性与性能。为此，作者提出 SynCLIP，一个同义词一致的语言-图像预训练框架，以增强 OVDP 的同义词鲁棒定位。SynCLIP 引入语义一致空间注意力对齐（SSA）模块，通过最小化原始表述与同义表述注意力图之间的差异来提升空间注意力一致性；并提出空间注意力精炼（SAR）模块，在对齐后的注意力图上有选择地强化语义最相关的空间区域，实现更精确稳定的定位。为支持同义词一致预训练，作者还构建了同义词增强视觉语料库 SEViC，为每个类别补充多个同义词与文本定义。多基准实验表明，SynCLIP 在多种语言变体下显著提升定位一致性，并在基于 CLIP 的 OVDP 方法中达到最优。
items.highlight_zh: 解决同义词引起的定位不一致，提升开放词汇密集感知鲁棒性
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么问题】开放词汇密集感知（OVDP）要借助文本知识去定位训练时没见过的物体，例如做分割或检测。现有基于 CLIP 的方法虽然进步很大，但作者发现一个隐蔽缺陷：同义词导致的定位不一致——同一含义的不同说法（如“狗”和“犬”）会让模型关注到不同的空间区域，输出忽左忽右，鲁棒性和精度都受影响。
【用了什么方法】作者提出 SynCLIP 预训练框架，专门增强对同义词的鲁棒定位。它包含两个模块：一是语义一致空间注意力对齐（SSA），通过最小化原始表述与同义表述的注意力图之间的差异，让模型对同义改写给出稳定的注意力；二是空间注意力精炼（SAR），在对齐后的注意力图上进一步强化语义最相关的区域，使定位更精确、更稳定。为支撑这类训练，作者还构建了同义词增强视觉语料库 SEViC，为每个类别补充多个同义词和文本定义。
【有什么结果】在多个基准上，SynCLIP 在各类语言变体下都明显提升了定位一致性，并在基于 CLIP 的 OVDP 方法中达到最优。代码已开源。
【为何重要】它指出了此前被忽视的“同义词一致性”问题，并给出数据、模块与训练目标成套的解决方案，让开放词汇感知在真实世界多样的语言表达下更可靠。

items.title_en: Latent Spectral Prompting for Multimodal Hyperspectral Object Tracking
items.title_zh: 面向多模态高光谱目标跟踪的潜在谱提示
items.abstract_en: Hyperspectral videos provide rich spectral signatures for robust tracking under challenging conditions such as camouflage and low illumination. However, limited hyperspectral annotations and the large RGB-hyperspectral domain gap hinder the direct use of modern temporally pretrained RGB trackers. We propose SProTrack, a multimodal framework that transfers temporal knowledge from pretrained RGB trackers to the hyperspectral domain through latent spectral prompting. The key idea is to decouple temporal modeling from spectral adaptation, allowing temporal dynamics to be inherited from RGB foundation models while hyperspectral information is learned from unlabeled data in a self-supervised manner. Unlike band-selection methods that discard most spectral information or prompt-based approaches that rely on local-search crops, SProTrack learns a global, scene-level spectral representation from the full hyperspectral frame using an autoencoder. This latent representation is used to guide spectral prompt extraction while a pretrained RGB tracker preserves strong temporal modeling on RGB-compatible inputs. By encoding spectral-spatial structure into compact latent prompts, SProTrack bridges the RGB-hyperspectral modality gap without extensive retraining or dense supervision. Experiments on HOT2020 and HOT2023 demonstrate that SProTrack achieves the best overall performance, with strong results across all spectral domains.
items.abstract_zh: 高光谱视频能在伪装、低照度下提供丰富光谱信息，但标注稀缺且RGB与高光谱域差异大，难以直接使用预训练RGB跟踪器。SProTrack用潜在光谱提示把RGB跟踪器的时序知识迁移到高光谱域，将时序建模与光谱适应解耦：时序继承自RGB基础模型，光谱信息以自监督方式从无标注数据学习。方法用自编码器从完整高光谱帧学习全局场景级光谱表示并引导提示提取。在HOT2020和HOT2023上总体性能最佳。
items.highlight_zh: 解耦时序建模与光谱适应，自监督桥接RGB—高光谱
items.digest_zh: 研究问题：高光谱视频每个像素有大量光谱通道，能区分颜色相近但材质不同的目标，适合伪装和暗光跟踪；但高光谱标注少，且与常见RGB视频差异大，直接套用RGB预训练跟踪器效果受限。方法：SProTrack不微调整个RGB跟踪器，而是先保留其时序建模能力，再用自编码器把整帧高光谱压缩成“场景级潜在光谱表示”，由它生成光谱提示并注入跟踪网络；光谱部分用无标签数据自监督学习。这样把“怎么随时间跟踪”和“怎么利用光谱”分开学。结果：在HOT2020、HOT2023基准上总体最优，跨不同光谱域都稳定。意义：减少对昂贵高光谱标注和密集监督的依赖，为把成熟RGB时序模型迁移到高光谱感知提供可复用思路。
items.comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)

items.title_en: ProAlign: Progressive Positional and Prototype-Guided Alignment for Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification
items.title_zh: ProAlign：面向空-地行人重识别的渐进式位置与原型引导对齐
items.abstract_en: Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification (AG-ReID) aims to match pedestrian images captured by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and ground-based surveillance cameras. The task remains highly challenging due to severe viewpoint discrepancies, frequent occlusions, and substantial domain gaps between aerial and ground imagery. Beyond these observable factors, existing methods often overlook two fundamental structural issues: cumulative positional drift during hierarchical feature extraction and semantic inconsistency across cross-view feature distributions. To address these challenges, we propose ProAlign, a Progressive Positional and Prototype-Guided Alignment Network for AG-ReID. ProAlign comprises two key components: a Layer-wise Progressive Positional Embedding (LPPE) module and a View-Aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (PCL) module. LPPE performs adaptive positional calibration throughout transformer layers by employing conditional positional encoding in shallow layers to mitigate local spatial distortions, while introducing learnable static positional embeddings in deeper layers to reinforce global semantic priors. Meanwhile, PCL maintains view-specific aerial and ground prototypes for each identity and enforces cross-view semantic consistency via a dual-prototype contrastive objective. Extensive experiments on CARGO and two real-world AG-ReID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of ProAlign, achieving state-of-the-art overall retrieval performance on CARGO with improvements of 1.60% in Rank-1 accuracy and 5.01% in mAP over the strongest competing methods.
items.abstract_zh: 空地行人重识别（AG-ReID）旨在匹配由无人机（UAV）和地面监控摄像头捕获的行人图像。由于严重的视角差异、频繁遮挡以及空中与地面图像之间的显著域差距，该任务仍极具挑战性。除这些可观察因素外，现有方法往往忽略两个基本结构问题：分层特征提取过程中的累积位置漂移，以及跨视角特征分布间的语义不一致。为应对这些挑战，我们提出ProAlign，一种用于AG-ReID的渐进式位置与原型引导对齐网络。ProAlign包含两个关键组件：逐层渐进位置嵌入（LPPE）模块和视角感知原型对比学习（PCL）模块。LPPE通过Transformer层执行自适应位置校准：在浅层采用条件位置编码以缓解局部空间畸变，同时在深层引入可学习静态位置嵌入以强化全局语义先验。同时，PCL为每个身份维护视角特定的空中和地面原型，并通过双原型对比目标强制跨视角语义一致性。在CARGO和两个真实世界AG-ReID基准上的大量实验证明了ProAlign的有效性，在CARGO上取得最先进的整体检索性能，相比最强竞争方法，Rank-1准确率提高1.60%，mAP提高5.01%。

items.title_en: ForceLDM: A Force-aware Latent Dynamics Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
items.title_zh: ForceLDM：面向富接触操作的力感知潜在动力学模型
items.abstract_en: Contact-rich manipulation requires fine-grained control and complex physical interactions with the environment, posing significant challenges for robot policy learning. Vision-only policies struggle with such tasks, as contact states and interaction forces are difficult to infer from visual observations alone. Existing methods mitigate this issue by incorporating force or tactile sensing. However, they often treat these signals as auxiliary observations without fully exploiting their role in modeling future interaction dynamics. To address this, we propose ForceLDM, a force-aware latent dynamics model that learns future contact and motion dynamics to guide action generation. Rather than directly predicting future observations, which can entangle task-relevant dynamics with irrelevant sensory details, ForceLDM learns a compact representation of future dynamics through knowledge distillation. Specifically, a teacher network with privileged future force/torque and optical flow signals extracts future dynamic features, which are then distilled into a student network trained only on current observations. This enables the student model to reason about upcoming contacts and physical dynamics without relying on future sensory inputs at deployment. To improve robustness and generalization, we further introduce a curriculum-based progressive noise injection strategy to mitigate over-reliance on future features. Experiments on five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks demonstrate that ForceLDM outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, generalizes effectively to novel objects, and remains robust to environmental perturbations. Project page and code are available at https://tpy001.github.io/ForceLDM/.
items.abstract_zh: 富接触操作需要细粒度控制以及与环境的复杂物理交互，这对机器人策略学习构成重大挑战。仅视觉策略在此类任务中表现不佳，因为仅从视觉观测难以推断接触状态和交互力。现有方法通过引入力或触觉传感来缓解这一问题。然而，它们通常将这些信号视为辅助观测，而未充分利用其在建模未来交互动力学中的作用。为此，我们提出ForceLDM，一种力感知潜在动力学模型，学习未来接触与运动动力学以指导动作生成。ForceLDM不直接预测未来观测（这可能将任务相关动力学与无关感官细节纠缠在一起），而是通过知识蒸馏学习未来动力学的紧凑表示。具体而言，一个具有特权未来力/力矩和光流信号的教师网络提取未来动态特征，然后将其蒸馏到仅用当前观测训练的学生网络中。这使学生模型能够在部署时无需依赖未来感官输入的情况下推理即将发生的接触和物理动力学。为提高鲁棒性和泛化性，我们进一步引入基于课程的渐进噪声注入策略，以缓解对未来特征的过度依赖。在五个真实世界富接触操作任务上的实验表明，ForceLDM优于最先进基线，能有效泛化到新物体，并对环境扰动保持鲁棒。项目页面和代码见 https://tpy001.github.io/ForceLDM/。

items.title_en: Stabilizing On-Policy Targeted Guidance in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 稳定智能体强化学习中的同策略目标引导
items.abstract_en: Naive on-policy RL is often bottlenecked by the capabilities of the base model --- insufficient coverage can result in an inability to learn from certain rewards. At the same time, rewards in modern post-training systems often come from rich textual sources, e.g. judge models with a rubric of criteria. Can we utilize such structures to provide a rich directional signal that enables improving on otherwise difficult to optimize rewards? In this work, we examine a framework we refer to as targeted guidance that learns from per-turn textual feedback via an on-policy self-distillation objective. Our focus is not only on directly improving hard-to-optimize behaviors, but on how to do so throughout the training process without degrading baseline RL performance. Over a range of settings across an agentic multi-turn software engineering environment, we find success by combining targeted self-distillation with a per-criteria RL reward, and by limiting feedback to turns where the policy specifically fails. We further examine the design choices that lead to stable entropy and reduce oscillatory behavior throughout training.
items.abstract_zh: 朴素同策略强化学习（RL）往往受基础模型能力瓶颈的限制——覆盖不足可能导致无法从某些奖励中学习。同时，现代后训练系统中的奖励通常来自丰富的文本来源，例如带有评分标准细则的评判模型。我们能否利用此类结构提供丰富的方向性信号，从而改进原本难以优化的奖励？在本工作中，我们研究了一个称为定向引导的框架，它通过同策略自蒸馏目标从逐轮文本反馈中学习。我们不仅关注直接改进难以优化的行为，还关注如何在整个训练过程中做到这一点而不降低基线RL性能。在智能体多轮软件工程环境的一系列设置中，我们发现，将定向自蒸馏与按准则的RL奖励相结合，并将反馈限制在策略具体失败的轮次，可以取得成功。我们进一步考察了导致稳定熵并减少训练过程中振荡行为的设计选择。

items.title_en: Navigational Safety of Marine Surface Vehicles in Restricted Visibility: From Intelligent Vision to Vision-Centered Multi-Sensor Fusion
items.title_zh: 受限能见度下水面船舶的航行安全：从智能视觉到以视觉为中心的多传感器融合
items.abstract_en: Marine surface vehicles (MSVs) have attracted considerable attention for their commercial, scientific, and military applications. Owing to their favorable performance-to-cost ratio, shipboard cameras are widely used to detect and recognize potentially hazardous situations across diverse operational scenarios. However, visual perception is inevitably degraded by restricted conditions, including irregular motion of the imaging platform, adverse weather, and long imaging distances. To improve situational awareness and navigation capabilities, complementary sensors, such as the automatic identification system (AIS), radar, and light detection and ranging (LiDAR), etc., have become essential shipboard equipment. Multi-sensor fusion can provide richer perceptual information and help ensure navigational safety of MSVs in restricted visibility. This article reviews recent progress from intelligent vision to vision-centered multi-sensor fusion for newcomers and researchers in intelligent ship navigation and intelligent waterborne transportation system (IWTS). After introducing the generation of quality-degraded images in restricted visibility, we will review intelligent vision methods for four key issues, i.e., shipboard video stabilization, visual perception enhancement, object detection and tracking, and navigable area segmentation. We then examine vision-centered multi-sensor fusion methods, including infrared-visible image fusion, radar-vision fusion, LiDAR-vision fusion, AIS-vision fusion, and other multi-sensor fusion scenarios. Open-source datasets and safety-critical applications are also summarized and discussed. Finally, we highlight open challenges and future research directions. The collected maritime datasets are available at https://github.com/MAPGroup/Datasets and will be regularly updated.
items.abstract_zh: 水面船舶（MSV）因其商业、科学和军事应用而受到广泛关注。由于其良好的性能成本比，船载摄像头被广泛用于在各种操作场景中检测和识别潜在危险情况。然而，视觉感知不可避免地会因受限条件而退化，包括成像平台的不规则运动、恶劣天气和长成像距离。为提高态势感知和导航能力，互补传感器（如自动识别系统（AIS）、雷达和激光雷达（LiDAR）等）已成为必不可少的船载设备。多传感器融合可提供更丰富的感知信息，并有助于确保MSV在受限能见度下的航行安全。本文面向智能船舶导航和智能水上运输系统（IWTS）领域的新手和研究人员，综述从智能视觉到以视觉为中心的多传感器融合的最新进展。在介绍受限能见度下质量退化图像的生成之后，我们将回顾针对四个关键问题的智能视觉方法，即船载视频稳定、视觉感知增强、目标检测与跟踪以及可航行区域分割。然后，我们考察以视觉为中心的多传感器融合方法，包括红外-可见光图像融合、雷达-视觉融合、激光雷达-视觉融合、AIS-视觉融合及其他多传感器融合场景。本文还总结和讨论了开源数据集和安全关键应用。最后，我们强调开放挑战和未来研究方向。收集的海事数据集可在 https://github.com/MAPGroup/Datasets 获取，并将定期更新。

items.title_en: Caging Vision-Language Navigation for Legged Robots via Barrier-Certified Safety Architecture
items.title_zh: 基于屏障认证安全架构的腿足机器人视觉-语言导航笼式约束
items.abstract_en: By harnessing the inherent commonsense capabilities of pretrained Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs), current Vision-Language Action(VLA) models for legged robots excel at interpreting language-based navigation commands but lack the physical grounding and explicit safety assurance required for real-world operation. Therefore, this paper aims to cage Legged-Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) through a safety architecture that provides physical grounding and ensures navigation safety. The key idea is not to abandon the powerful capabilities of end-to-end VLA planning, but rather to augment and cage them. In particular, we integrate a high-level VLA planner with a low-level physical-grounding layer that leverages efficient state estimation, in-situ 3D spatial perception, and an Signed Distance Field (SDF) representation to generate executable trajectories. We provide a navigation planner with provable collision-avoidance guarantees under the stated assumptions by combining a low-dimensional Bezier-parameterized MPPI planner with Discrete Exponential Barrier Function (dEBF) constraints. The proposed Legged-VLN system is modular, making it compatible with various VLM/VLA models and agnostic to the robot platform. The proposed system is validated with extensive real-world experiments on humanoid and quadrupedal robots, demonstrating versatile, efficient, and safe vision-language driven navigation capabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 通过利用预训练大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）固有的常识能力，当前用于腿式机器人的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型擅长解释基于语言的导航命令，但缺乏实际运行所需的物理接地和明确的安全保证。因此，本文旨在通过一种安全架构来笼护腿式视觉语言导航（VLN），该架构提供物理接地并确保导航安全。关键思想不是放弃端到端VLA规划的强大能力，而是增强并约束它们。具体而言，我们将高层VLA规划器与低层物理接地层集成，后者利用高效状态估计、原位3D空间感知和符号距离场（SDF）表示来生成可执行轨迹。通过将低维Bezier参数化MPPI规划器与离散指数屏障函数（dEBF）约束相结合，我们提供了在所述假设下具有可证明避碰保证的导航规划器。所提出的Legged-VLN系统是模块化的，使其兼容各种VLM/VLA模型，并且与机器人平台无关。该系统在人形机器人和四足机器人上进行了大量真实世界实验验证，展示了多样、高效且安全的视觉语言驱动导航能力。

items.title_en: OdorSpaces: Visual-Olfactory Embodied Navigation in 3D Environments
items.title_zh: OdorSpaces：三维环境中的视觉-嗅觉具身导航
items.abstract_en: Olfaction provides critical information about airborne chemical cues, yet it remains largely underexplored in embodied AI, with limited prior machine olfaction work focusing primarily on semantic odor perception. We introduce OdorSpaces, a physics-based simulation platform and benchmark for visual-olfactory embodied navigation. OdorSpaces augments Habitat-Sim with 3D odor transport and dispersion simulated by Fire Dynamics Simulator (FDS), enabling agents to navigate photorealistic indoor environments using both visual and olfactory observations. The benchmark includes two representative source-seeking scenarios: invisible gas-leak localization and early-stage fire localization. We develop an initial multimodal reinforcement learning policy that integrates visual observations and olfactory measurements over time. Experiments show that the policy outperforms a diverse set of baselines, establishing a strong reference for future research on visual-olfactory embodied navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 嗅觉提供关于空气中化学线索的关键信息，但在具身AI中仍很大程度上未被充分探索，此前有限的机器嗅觉工作主要集中于语义气味感知。我们提出OdorSpaces，一个用于视觉-嗅觉具身导航的基于物理的仿真平台与基准。OdorSpaces通过Fire Dynamics Simulator（FDS）模拟的三维气味输运与扩散来增强Habitat-Sim，使智能体能够利用视觉和嗅觉观测在照片级真实感室内环境中导航。该基准包括两个代表性寻源场景：不可见气体泄漏定位和早期火灾定位。我们开发了一个初始多模态强化学习策略，随时间整合视觉观测和嗅觉测量。实验表明，该策略优于多种基线，为未来视觉-嗅觉具身导航研究建立了强参考。

items.title_en: Policy Network Diffusion
items.title_zh: 策略网络扩散
items.abstract_en: Diffusion models have shown remarkable progress in AI-generated content, including images and videos. In this paper, we explore whether diffusion models can generate the parameters of policy networks in reinforcement learning (RL), and whether the generated policies exhibit generalization capabilities. To achieve this, we propose Diffusion-based Conditional Policy Network Parameter Generation (DPPG), which consists of a Transformer-based autoencoder and a task-conditioned diffusion model. The autoencoder achieves a high compression rate by patchifying network parameters, while the task-conditioned diffusion model generates corresponding parameters conditioned on different environments. Our experiments demonstrate that, with a single unified DPPG model, we can synthesize high-quality policies across a diverse set of tasks from different environment domains, including Classic Control, Atari games, and MuJoCo. Additionally, our method can generate networks with a larger number of parameters compared to previous approaches. Furthermore, we find that in previously unseen environments, DPPG can generate parameters that achieve faster convergence and reach competitive performance, showcasing the potential future applications of parameter generation via diffusion.
items.abstract_zh: 扩散模型在AI生成内容（包括图像和视频）方面已取得显著进展。本文探讨扩散模型能否生成强化学习（RL）中策略网络的参数，以及生成的策略是否表现出泛化能力。为此，我们提出基于扩散的条件策略网络参数生成（DPPG），它由基于Transformer的自编码器和任务条件扩散模型组成。自编码器通过对网络参数进行分块实现高压缩率，而任务条件扩散模型则根据不同环境生成相应参数。实验表明，使用单个统一的DPPG模型，我们可以在来自不同环境领域的多样任务上合成高质量策略，包括Classic Control、Atari游戏和MuJoCo。此外，与先前方法相比，我们的方法能够生成参数数量更多的网络。进一步地，我们发现在先前未见过的环境中，DPPG可以生成参数，实现更快收敛并达到有竞争力的性能，展示了通过扩散进行参数生成的未来潜在应用。

items.title_en: Near-Minimax Sample Complexity for Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning under Generative Models
items.title_zh: 生成模型下多目标强化学习的近极小极大样本复杂度
items.abstract_en: In multi-objective reinforcement learning, preferences may be specified only after data collection, requiring one dataset to support a continuum of reward trade-offs. We study finite discounted Markov decision processes with unknown transitions, $S$ states, $A$ actions, and $m$ known reward functions taking values in $[0,1]$, given access to a generative model. The learner must provide an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy for every convex combination of these rewards without further sampling, with a guarantee that holds simultaneously over all preferences and initial states. Writing $H=(1-γ)^{-1}$, we establish the constant-confidence minimax sample complexity $\widetildeΘ\!\left( \frac{SAH^3}{\varepsilon^2}\min\{S,\log(em)\} \right)$, where the suppressed factors are logarithmic in $S,A,H,\varepsilon^{-1}$ and the dependence on $m$ is explicit. Thus, up to these logarithmic factors, the worst-case statistical cost of supporting all preferences grows logarithmically with the number of objectives and saturates at the number of states. The upper bound uses uniform state--action sampling and empirical planning, with reward rounding in the logarithmic-objective regime. Its analysis chains optimal-value increments over covers of the reward hull. A one-sided Bellman variance bound controls signed value differences under a second transition kernel, preserving the $H^3\varepsilon^{-2}$ dependence. A complementary uniform guarantee for all bounded rewards yields the state-dimension saturation. We establish lower bounds matching up to logarithmic factors through a rare-exit construction with subset rewards and action encoding. These bounds apply to adaptive simulator queries and arbitrary randomized history-dependent output policies, while the upper bounds are attained by deterministic stationary policies.
items.abstract_zh: 在多目标强化学习中，偏好可能仅在数据收集之后才被指定，因此需要单个数据集支持连续的奖励权衡。我们研究转移未知、具有S个状态、A个动作和m个已知奖励函数（取值于[0,1]）的有限折扣马尔可夫决策过程，并可访问生成模型。学习器必须在不进一步采样的情况下，为这些奖励的每个凸组合提供ε-最优策略，且保证同时对所有偏好和初始状态成立。记H=(1-γ)^{-1}，我们建立常数置信度下的极小极大样本复杂度\widetildeΘ\!\left( \frac{SAH^3}{\varepsilon^2}\min\{S,\log(em)\} \right)，其中省略因子为S、A、H、ε^{-1}的对数，且对m的依赖是显式的。因此，在这些对数因子范围内，支持所有偏好的最坏情况统计代价随目标数量对数增长，并在状态数量处饱和。上界使用均匀状态-动作采样和经验规划，并在对数目标机制中进行奖励舍入。其分析在奖励凸包的覆盖上链接最优值增量。一个单侧Bellman方差界在第二转移核下控制带符号值差异，保持H^3ε^{-2}依赖。对所有有界奖励的补充统一保证产生状态维度饱和。我们通过采用子集奖励和动作编码的稀有退出构造，建立在对数因子内匹配的下界。这些界适用于自适应模拟器查询和任意随机化、依赖历史的输出策略，而上界由确定性平稳策略达到。

items.title_en: CANDO: Conservative Action-Noise Directional Optimization for Residual Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: CANDO：用于残差强化学习的保守动作-噪声方向优化
items.abstract_en: Pretrained generative policies provide strong behavior priors for robot control, but adapting them efficiently with online reinforcement learning remains difficult. A central challenge is how to improve a frozen generative policy without destroying the structure learned from offline demonstrations. Noise-space residual methods address this by modifying the policy's input noise, but existing noise-space methods typically regulate adaptation through fixed latent feasible regions, which may exclude valuable noise edits. In contrast, action-space residual methods are more sample-efficient, but their efficiency can still be further improved. We propose Conservative Noise Directional Optimization (CNDO), a noise-space residual RL method that improves a frozen generative policy by learning state- and noise-conditioned directions around Gaussian latent samples. CNDO removes predefined latent feasible regions and instead regulates noise-space adaptation through the soft conservative constraint, which consists of conservative value estimation and gated execution. We further introduce Conservative Action-Noise Directional Optimization (CANDO), which adds an action-space residual, combining structured latent-space improvement with local action correction. Experiments show that, once CNDO narrows the gap between noise-space and action-space residual learning, CANDO further improves over single-space optimization, achieving 76.1 NAUC and a 91.4% final success rate, surpassing the best single-space results by 6.6 NAUC and 4.1% success rate. More demos and info are available on https://cando-rl.github.io/.
items.abstract_zh: 预训练生成策略为机器人控制提供强行为先验，但用在线强化学习高效地适配它们仍然困难。一个核心挑战是如何改进冻结的生成策略，同时不破坏从离线演示中学到的结构。噪声空间残差方法通过修改策略的输入噪声来解决这一问题，但现有噪声空间方法通常通过固定的潜在可行区域来规范适配，这可能排除有价值的噪声编辑。相比之下，动作空间残差方法样本效率更高，但其效率仍可进一步提升。我们提出保守噪声方向优化（CNDO），一种噪声空间残差RL方法，通过在高斯潜在样本周围学习以状态和噪声为条件的方向来改进冻结的生成策略。CNDO去除了预定义的潜在可行区域，转而通过软保守约束来规范噪声空间适配，该约束由保守价值估计和门控执行组成。我们进一步提出保守动作-噪声方向优化（CANDO），它加入动作空间残差，将结构化的潜在空间改进与局部动作校正相结合。实验表明，一旦CNDO缩小了噪声空间与动作空间残差学习之间的差距，CANDO便在单空间优化基础上进一步提升，达到76.1 NAUC和91.4%的最终成功率，比最佳单空间结果分别高出6.6 NAUC和4.1%成功率。更多演示和信息见 https://cando-rl.github.io/。

items.title_en: CLOCs-R: Radar-Assisted Camera-LiDAR Fusion for Long-Range Object Detection
items.title_zh: CLOCs-R：面向远距离目标检测的雷达辅助相机-激光雷达融合
items.abstract_en: Long-range 3D object detection remains difficult for autonomous vehicles because LiDAR returns become sparse and camera evidence weakens with distance, while automotive radar keeps returning measurements far beyond both. We present CLOCs-R, an extension of the CLOCs candidate-level fusion framework that adds radar evidence to camera-LiDAR rescoring. Radar returns are accumulated over several sweeps, compensated for ego-motion, and associated with each pre-NMS 3D candidate through a range-dependent gate. Compact features summarizing support, Doppler speed and spread, range residual, and offset are then appended to every camera-LiDAR pair before a lightweight fusion network rescores the candidates. We first verify that our fusion implementation reproduces CLOCs on KITTI. We then evaluate on the daytime clear-weather subset of the aiMotive dataset, reporting distance-binned metrics out to 200 m with frozen SECOND and Cascade R-CNN detectors. Camera-LiDAR CLOCs improves on SECOND up to 50 m but degrades beyond it. A residual scoring variant, introduced post hoc, corrects SECOND's score instead of replacing it and recovers most of this loss. Radar consistently improves BEV AP at 30-50 m (0.857 to 0.870), but beyond 50 m its gain is small (+0.003 center-distance AP), within seed variation, and CLOCs-R with residual scoring is statistically tied with LiDAR-only SECOND. Our analysis attributes the limited long-range benefit to weak separation of true and false detections by radar features, scarce far-range training positives, poor camera evidence at distance, and missing LiDAR proposals that rescoring cannot recover. We report all as-designed and post hoc results side by side.
items.abstract_zh: 远距离3D目标检测对自动驾驶车辆仍然困难，因为LiDAR回波随距离变得稀疏，相机证据随距离减弱，而汽车雷达仍能在远超二者的距离上持续返回测量。我们提出CLOCs-R，它是CLOCs候选级融合框架的扩展，将雷达证据加入相机-激光雷达重打分。雷达回波在多次扫描中累积，进行自运动补偿，并通过距离相关门控与每个NMS前的3D候选关联。随后，在轻量融合网络对候选重打分之前，将概括支持度、多普勒速度和扩展、距离残差及偏移的紧凑特征追加到每个相机-激光雷达对上。我们首先验证我们的融合实现能在KITTI上复现CLOCs。然后在aiMotive数据集的白天晴天子集上评估，报告在冻结SECOND和Cascade R-CNN检测器下最远至200 m的分距离桶指标。相机-激光雷达CLOCs在50 m以内优于SECOND，但超过50 m后性能下降。事后引入的一种残差打分变体校正SECOND的分数而不是替换它，并恢复了大部分损失。雷达在30-50 m一致提升BEV AP（0.857至0.870），但超过50 m后增益很小（+0.003中心距离AP），处于种子变化范围内，并且采用残差打分的CLOCs-R与仅LiDAR的SECOND在统计上持平。我们的分析将有限的远距离收益归因于雷达特征对真伪检测的区分较弱、远距离训练正样本稀缺、远距离相机证据差，以及缺失的LiDAR提议无法通过重打分恢复。我们并排报告所有按设计结果和事后结果。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Towards Robust Multi-Modal Semantic Segmentation with Teache
items.title_en: Towards Robust Multi-Modal Semantic Segmentation with Teacher-Student Framework and Hybrid Prototype Distillation
items.title_zh: 面向鲁棒多模态语义分割的教师-学生框架与混合原型蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Multimodal semantic segmentation (MMSS) faces significant challenges in real-world applications due to incomplete, degraded, or missing sensor data. To address this, we propose RobustSeg, an efficient teacher-student framework that enhances model robustness under missing-modality conditions while maintaining strong performance in full-modality scenarios. RobustSeg adopts a feedback-based self-distillation paradigm consisting of two complementary stages. Firstly, we introduce Hybrid Prototype Distillation (HPD), which enables more reliable knowledge transfer of both cross-modal and modality-specific aspects. Concretely, combined with dominant-modality selection, HPD performs cross-modal semantic distillation with high-level semantic prototypes to reduce modality bias. Meanwhile, HPD conducts intra-class feature variation distillation for modality-specific structural details. Secondly, to enable the teacher model to gradually produce more balanced and robust modality representations, we make the student model provide feedback from the non-dominant modality to the teacher, benefiting the entire distillation process. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art robustness (e.g., +2.40% missing-modality performance on DeLiVER) while causing almost no degradation in full-modality performance (only -0.1% mIoU). Moreover, evaluations using different backbones (AnySeg and CMNeXt) further validate the generalization ability of RobustSeg.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态语义分割（MMSS）因传感器数据不完整、退化或缺失而在真实应用中面临重大挑战。为解决这一问题，我们提出RobustSeg，一种高效的教师-学生框架，在缺失模态条件下增强模型鲁棒性，同时在完整模态场景中保持强劲性能。RobustSeg采用基于反馈的自蒸馏范式，由两个互补阶段组成。首先，我们引入混合原型蒸馏（HPD），它能够对跨模态和模态特定方面进行更可靠的知识迁移。具体而言，结合主导模态选择，HPD利用高层语义原型执行跨模态语义蒸馏，以减少模态偏差。同时，HPD针对模态特定结构细节执行类内特征变化蒸馏。其次，为使教师模型逐步产生更平衡、更鲁棒的模态表示，我们让学生模型向教师提供来自非主导模态的反馈，从而使整个蒸馏过程受益。在三个数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法实现了最先进的鲁棒性（例如，在DeLiVER上缺失模态性能+2.40%），同时几乎不造成完整模态性能下降（仅-0.1% mIoU）。此外，使用不同骨干网络（AnySeg和CMNeXt）的评估进一步验证了RobustSeg的泛化能力。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:ExtrinSplat: Decoupling Geometry and Semantics for Open-Voca
items.title_en: ExtrinSplat: Decoupling Geometry and Semantics for Open-Vocabulary Understanding in 3D Gaussian Splatting
items.title_zh: ExtrinSplat：解耦几何与语义以实现3D高斯泼溅中的开放词汇理解
items.abstract_en: Lifting 2D open-vocabulary understanding into 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes is a critical challenge. Mainstream methods, built on an embedding paradigm, suffer from three key flaws: (i) geometry-semantic inconsistency, where points, rather than objects, serve as the semantic basis, limiting semantic fidelity; (ii) semantic bloat from injecting gigabytes of feature data into the geometry; and (iii) semantic rigidity, as one feature per Gaussian struggles to capture rich polysemy. To overcome these limitations, we introduce ExtrinSplat, a framework built on the extrinsic paradigm that decouples geometry from semantics. Instead of embedding features, ExtrinSplat clusters Gaussians into multi-granularity, overlapping 3D object groups. A Vision-Language Model (VLM) then interprets these groups to generate lightweight textual hypotheses, creating an extrinsic index layer that natively supports complex polysemy. By replacing costly feature embedding with lightweight indices, ExtrinSplat reduces scene adaptation time from hours to minutes and lowers storage overhead by several orders of magnitude. On benchmark tasks for open-vocabulary 3D object selection and semantic segmentation, ExtrinSplat outperforms established embedding-based frameworks, validating the efficacy and efficiency of the proposed extrinsic paradigm.
items.abstract_zh: 将2D开放词汇理解提升到3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景是一项关键挑战。构建于嵌入范式的主流方法存在三个关键缺陷：（i）几何-语义不一致，其中点而非对象作为语义基础，限制了语义保真度；（ii）语义膨胀，因为将数GB的特征数据注入几何中；（iii）语义刚性，因为每个高斯一个特征难以捕捉丰富的多义性。为克服这些局限，我们提出ExtrinSplat，一个构建于外蕴范式、将几何与语义解耦的框架。ExtrinSplat不嵌入特征，而是将高斯聚类为多粒度、重叠的3D对象组。随后，视觉-语言模型（VLM）解释这些组以生成轻量文本假设，创建一个原生支持复杂多义性的外蕴索引层。通过用轻量索引替代昂贵的特征嵌入，ExtrinSplat将场景适应时间从数小时缩短至数分钟，并将存储开销降低数个数量级。在开放词汇3D对象选择和语义分割的基准任务上，ExtrinSplat优于已有基于嵌入的框架，验证了所提外蕴范式的有效性和效率。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:Vocabulary Scaling Law: Tuning Open-vocabulary Predictors fo
items.title_en: Vocabulary Scaling Law: Tuning Open-vocabulary Predictors for Their Openness
items.title_zh: 词汇缩放定律：为开放性调优开放词汇预测器
items.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary learning on CLIP provides remarkable generalization on diverse concepts, however, falters under the realistic streaming open-world evaluations for Stability against distractor classes and Extensibility to novel classes. Current fine-tuning methods often fail these tests since they are mainly designed for closed-set conditions, leading to the performance gaps while the target vocabulary progressively scales. We formalize a "vocabulary scaling law" showing that these openness measures can be lower-bounded by performance on the full class-name universe, implying that robust fine-tuning should: (i) account for the entire vocabulary, (ii) tune class-name embeddings rather than context, and (iii) enforce orthogonality between prompt embeddings including training and open-set class names. Guided by our analysis, we propose Submodular-Vocabulary Fine-tuning (SVFT), a bi-level optimization framework that approximates the intractable objective of tuning all class name embedding by greedily selecting a small, informative subset of class names via constrained submodular maximization, thus, allows the employment of efficient greedy algorithm for the near-optimal class-name subset selection to fine-tune CLIP instead of using all open classes. Across extensive experiments, SVFT consistently improves both stability and extensibility, advancing the openness and practical robustness of CLIP-based vision-language models.
items.abstract_zh: 在CLIP上进行开放词汇学习可在多样概念上提供显著泛化能力，但在现实流式开放世界评估中，面对对干扰类别的稳定性和对新类别的可扩展性时仍会失效。当前的微调方法常常无法通过这些测试，因为它们主要针对闭集条件设计，导致目标词汇逐步扩展时出现性能差距。我们形式化了一个“词汇缩放定律”，表明这些开放性度量可由在完整类名全集上的性能给出下界，这意味着稳健的微调应当：（i）考虑整个词汇；（ii）调优类名嵌入而非上下文；（iii）在包括训练类名和开放集类名的提示嵌入之间强制正交性。在我们的分析指导下，我们提出子模词汇微调（Submodular-Vocabulary Fine-tuning，SVFT），一个双层优化框架，它通过约束子模最大化贪心地选择一小部分信息量大的类名，来近似调优所有类名嵌入这一难以处理的目标，从而允许采用高效贪心算法进行近最优的类名子集选择，以微调CLIP，而不是使用所有开放类别。在大量实验中，SVFT持续提升稳定性和可扩展性，推进了基于CLIP的视觉-语言模型的开放性和实际鲁棒性。

items.id: cvf:CVPR2026:OpenVoxel: Training-Free Grouping and Captioning Voxels for
items.title_en: OpenVoxel: Training-Free Grouping and Captioning Voxels for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding
items.title_zh: OpenVoxel：面向开放词汇3D场景理解的免训练体素分组与描述
items.abstract_en: We propose OpenVoxel, a training-free algorithm for grouping and captioning sparse voxels for the open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding tasks. Given the sparse voxel rasterization (SVR) model obtained from multi-view images of a 3D scene, our OpenVoxel is able to produce meaningful groups that describe different objects in the scene. Also, by leveraging powerful Vision Language Models (VLMs) and Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs), our OpenVoxel successfully build an informative scene map by captioning each group, enabling further 3D scene understanding tasks such as open-vocabulary segmentation (OVS) or referring expression segmentation (RES). Unlike previous methods, our method is training-free and does not introduce embeddings from a CLIP/BERT text encoder. Instead, we directly proceed with text-to-text search using MLLMs. Through extensive experiments, our method demonstrates superior performance compared to recent studies, particularly in complex referring expression segmentation (RES) tasks.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出OpenVoxel，一种用于开放词汇3D场景理解任务的无训练算法，用于对稀疏体素进行分组和生成描述。给定由3D场景的多视图图像获得的稀疏体素光栅化（SVR）模型，我们的OpenVoxel能够生成描述场景中不同对象的有意义分组。此外，通过利用强大的视觉语言模型（VLM）和多模态大语言模型（MLLM），我们的OpenVoxel通过对每个分组生成描述，成功构建信息丰富的场景地图，从而支持进一步的3D场景理解任务，例如开放词汇分割（OVS）或指称表达分割（RES）。与先前方法不同，我们的方法无需训练，并且不引入来自CLIP/BERT文本编码器的嵌入。相反，我们直接使用MLLM进行文本到文本搜索。通过大量实验，我们的方法相比近期研究展现出更优性能，尤其是在复杂的指称表达分割（RES）任务中。

items.title_en: GeoDIVE: Geospatial Descent Informed by Value Estimation
items.title_zh: GeoDIVE：由价值估计引导的地理空间下降
items.abstract_en: Finding specific objects, structures, and spatial patterns supports critical work in agriculture, infrastructure planning, environmental monitoring, and disaster response. These features, however, are often dispersed across very large regions and span dramatically different spatial scales, which defines a search space that is costly to embed, maintain, and search naively. We introduce GeoDIVE, a model that treats a multiresolution satellite image gallery as a forest and uses best-first traversal to determine which tiles to encode. At each visited node, a lightweight model then predicts an optimistic estimate of the best query similarity hidden among its descendants using the query and subtree representations. In evaluations with image and open-vocabulary text queries, GeoDIVE matches exhaustive search at 10% of the encoding cost for image queries and leads all tested baselines at every budget in both modalities. To support future evaluation of multiscale geospatial search, we also release object-level image and text queries for Git-10M, constructed from Microsoft building footprints and OpenStreetMap polygons with VLM-generated captions. Source code and models will be made publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 查找特定对象、结构和空间模式可支持农业、基础设施规划、环境监测和灾害响应中的关键工作。然而，这些特征通常分散在非常大的区域，并跨越显著不同的空间尺度，这定义了一个若朴素地嵌入、维护和搜索则代价高昂的搜索空间。我们提出GeoDIVE，一种将多分辨率卫星图像库视为森林并使用最佳优先遍历来确定要编码哪些瓦片的模型。在每个访问节点，轻量模型随后利用查询和子树表示，预测其后代中隐藏的最佳查询相似度的乐观估计。在使用图像查询和开放词汇文本查询的评估中，GeoDIVE在图像查询上以10%的编码成本达到与穷举搜索相当的结果，并在两种模态的每个预算下领先所有测试基线。为支持未来多尺度地理空间搜索的评估，我们还发布了Git-10M的对象级图像和文本查询，这些查询由Microsoft建筑轮廓和OpenStreetMap多边形结合VLM生成的描述构建。源代码和模型将公开提供。
items.comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. Includes supplementary material

items.title_en: Say the Same, Act Differently: Diagnosing and Steering Text-Action Divergence in Reasoning VLAs
items.title_zh: 言同而行异：推理型VLA中文本-动作偏离的诊断与引导
items.abstract_en: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models pair physical control with natural-language rationales that supervisors can read to monitor embodied safety. Prior attacks on VLA reasoning corrupt the rationale itself and leave visible evidence in the text. We show that visual perturbations can instead alter the physical action while keeping the generated rationale word-for-word identical. At the shared text/action interface of Alpamayo for driving and InstructVLA for manipulation, our text-neutral action-subspace (TNAS) diagnostic shows that the locally most action-sensitive direction is nearly orthogonal to the active text-loss gradients, with 1.87% and 5.28% norm overlap. At equal hidden-state perturbation norms across both models, interventions along this text-neutral residual shift actions 4.64x to 47.8x more than text-gradient perturbations, whereas text-gradient perturbations induce 21.2x to 277x more text drift. Steering visual perturbations along this direction reaches the same decoupling from the image. Across 154 obstacle-annotated driving scenes in Alpamayo, TNAS-guided attacks induce a new collision under a word-for-word identical rationale in 52.6% of scenes under full-image perturbations and 35.1% under a localized forward-camera patch, compared with 4.55% for unguided action attacks. Relative to a text-preserving baseline, TNAS guidance raises exact rationale preservation from 83.0% to 89.5% and cuts teacher-forced text drift by 68.4% at a comparable collision rate. In InstructVLA, TNAS guidance cuts text drift by 40.5% and preserves the exact response on 85.0% of examples alongside a 1.73-unit action-chunk shift. An unchanged rationale therefore cannot certify a safe action, so monitors for reasoning VLAs must verify the predicted action channel directly.
items.abstract_zh: 推理型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将物理控制与自然语言理由配对，监督者可阅读这些理由以监控具身安全。先前针对VLA推理的攻击会破坏理由本身，并在文本中留下可见证据。我们表明，视觉扰动反而可以改变物理动作，同时使生成的理由逐字不变。在用于驾驶的Alpamayo和用于操作的InstructVLA共享的文本/动作接口处，我们的文本中性动作子空间（TNAS）诊断表明，局部对动作最敏感的方向与活跃的文本损失梯度几乎正交，范数重叠分别为1.87%和5.28%。在两个模型上隐藏状态扰动范数相等时，沿该文本中性残差方向的干预使动作偏移比文本梯度扰动多4.64倍至47.8倍，而文本梯度扰动引起的文本漂移多21.2倍至277倍。沿该方向操控视觉扰动，可实现与图像相同的解耦效果。在Alpamayo的154个带障碍物标注的驾驶场景中，TNAS引导的攻击在理由逐字相同的情况下，在全图像扰动下于52.6%的场景中诱发新的碰撞，在局部前视相机图像块下于35.1%的场景中诱发新的碰撞，相比之下，无引导的动作攻击为4.55%。相对于文本保持基线，TNAS引导将理由完全保持率从83.0%提高到89.5%，并在相当碰撞率下将教师强制文本漂移降低68.4%。在InstructVLA中，TNAS引导将文本漂移降低40.5%，并在85.0%的示例上保持完全相同的响应，同时伴随1.73个单位的动作块偏移。因此，未改变的理由不能证明动作安全，推理型VLA的监控器必须直接验证预测的动作通道。
items.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables

items.title_en: Diversity-Aware Experience Replay via Statistical Leverage Scores
items.title_zh: 基于统计杠杆分数的多样性感知经验回放
items.abstract_en: Off-policy deep reinforcement learning trains on random samples from a replay buffer of past experience. In physical robot settings, that buffer is dominated by routine: thousands of near-identical transitions from normal operation, while the rare events that define the edges of the task are rarely sampled. We propose scoring every stored transition by its statistical leverage, which measures how unusual it is relative to the buffer's own data, computed from the stored numbers alone, with no labels, rewards, or value network. We draw each mini-batch from a mixture of this score and uniform sampling. First, the natural way to build the score along the directions where the data varies most turns out to be blind when actions are stored as one-hot indicators, because indicator columns always win the variance ranking; we instead select the feature columns with the heaviest tails (largest kurtosis) where small far-away populations are revealed. Second, the importance weights that prioritized replay uses to keep gradients unbiased cancel the method exactly: with full correction, training matches uniform sampling, so we drop the correction and deliberately optimize the rebalanced objective. Third, when the rare situations of a log are relational, visible only in how a stretch of behavior relates to its goal, not in any single stored coordinate-per-transition scores are blind; applying the same tail rule to short trajectory windows described relative to their goal restores the signal, and on a three-joint arm that must push an object around an obstacle it raises the rare-task success from 0.49 to 0.69 against a labeled-oracle ceiling of 0.74.
items.abstract_zh: 离策略深度强化学习基于来自过去经验回放缓冲区的随机样本进行训练。在物理机器人场景中，该缓冲区被常规操作主导：来自正常操作的数千个几乎相同的转移，而定义任务边界的稀有事件很少被采样。我们提出用统计杠杆分数为每个存储的转移打分，该分数衡量其相对于缓冲区自身数据有多不寻常，仅由存储的数值计算，无需标签、奖励或价值网络。我们从该分数与均匀采样的混合中抽取每个小批量。首先，当动作存储为独热指示变量时，沿数据变化最大的方向构建分数的自然方式会被证明是盲目的，因为指示变量列总是在方差排序中胜出；我们转而选择尾部最重（峰度最大）的特征列，在那里小的远离群体得以显现。其次，优先经验回放为保持梯度无偏而使用的重要性权重会完全抵消该方法：在完全校正下，训练与均匀采样相同，因此我们放弃校正，并有意优化重新平衡后的目标。第三，当日志中的稀有情境是关系性的，仅体现在一段行为与其目标的关系中，而不体现在任何单个存储坐标中时，逐转移分数会失效；对相对于其目标描述的短轨迹窗口应用相同的尾部规则可恢复信号，并且在必须绕过障碍物推动物体的三关节机械臂上，它将稀有任务成功率从0.49提高到0.69，而带标签的预言机上限为0.74。

items.title_en: Asynchronous Robot Policies
items.title_zh: 异步机器人策略
items.abstract_en: Scaling vision-language foundation models has significantly advanced generalist robot manipulation, but the increased model scale introduces computational latency that degrades real-time physical reactivity. Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures execute high-level semantic reasoning and action ex- ecution sequentially within the primary control loop, creating a fundamental tension between semantic-reasoning capability and robot agility. To address this, we propose Asynchronous Robot Policy (ARP), an architectural framework that decouples semantic reasoning from low-level action generation using asynchronous processes operating at independent frequencies. In ARP, a high-capacity Vision-Language Model (VLM) asynchronously updates a semantic memory at low fre- quency, while a lightweight Vision-Action Expert, conditioned on this semantic memory, generates robot actions at a much higher control frequency. Such a formulation, enables having a fast perception-action loop without compromising on the semantic capability. To overcome asynchronous memory staleness, ARP trains the vision-action expert on the semantic staleness and execution delay, with temporally mismatched observation across processes. On Franka manipulation tasks, ARP achieves an 18% higher success rate and 20% less time need for execution in quasi-static setups, while 3-5 times baseline performance in dynamic simulation environments. Furthermore, ARP enables operating the VLM at 10 times lower than its nominal frequency with no significant performance loss making it much more efficient than the baseline. These results highlight the architectural advantages of modeling robot policies as asynchronous processes, enabling real-world reactive deployment without sacrificing the scale of foundation models.
items.abstract_zh: 扩展视觉-语言基础模型已显著推进通用机器人操作，但模型规模增大会引入计算时延，从而降低实时物理反应能力。现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）架构在主控制回路中顺序执行高层语义推理和动作执行，造成语义推理能力与机器人敏捷性之间的根本性矛盾。为解决此问题，我们提出异步机器人策略（ARP），一种使用以独立频率运行的异步进程将语义推理与低层动作生成解耦的架构框架。在 ARP 中，高容量视觉-语言模型（VLM）以低频率异步更新语义记忆，而一个以该语义记忆为条件的轻量级视觉-动作专家以高得多的控制频率生成机器人动作。这种形式能够在不必牺牲语义能力的情况下实现快速感知-动作回路。为克服异步记忆陈旧问题，ARP 使用跨进程时间不匹配的观测，针对语义陈旧和执行延迟训练视觉-动作专家。在 Franka 操作任务上，ARP 在准静态设置中实现了高 18% 的成功率和减少 20% 的执行所需时间，而在动态仿真环境中达到基线性能的 3-5 倍。此外，ARP 能够以比其标称频率低 10 倍的频率运行 VLM，且无显著性能损失，使其比基线高效得多。这些结果突显了将机器人策略建模为异步进程的架构优势，使得无需牺牲基础模型规模即可进行真实世界反应式部署。
items.comment: For code, checkpoints and more results, check out https://arp.insait.ai

items.title_en: Revisiting Critic Estimation in Soft Actor-Critic Algorithms
items.title_zh: 重新审视Soft Actor-Critic算法中的Critic估计
items.abstract_en: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) is a widely used deep reinforcement learning algorithm that combines entropy regularization with an actor-critic architecture. Standard implementations rely on one-step temporal-difference learning of Q-functions, yet alternative critic design choices remain underexplored. In this work, we revisit three such choices: learning soft advantages instead of soft Q-values, the use of multi-step return targets, and the training of multi-step critics from replay buffer data. Keeping the policy objective fixed, we compare the six critic variants these choices generate: (i) advantage and (ii) dueling-advantage critics learned from one-step transitions, and $λ$-return and soft Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE) critics learned either (iii, iv) on-policy or (v, vi) from replayed trajectory segments. Each variant is evaluated across an entire random hyperparameter search on fourteen tasks, treating the hyperparameters as part of the algorithm. Learning soft advantages instead of soft Q-values does not improve performance, and the soft GAE critic adds nothing over the simpler $λ$-return critic. What does improve performance, most clearly on continuous control, is training a $λ$-return critic on replayed trajectory segments, even without importance weighting or trace cutting. This extends earlier evidence that uncorrected multi-step targets work well under replay to the full soft $λ$-return, entropy terms included. By design, the underlying ideas studied here extend beyond SAC, and our empirical findings aim to encourage their application to a broader class of reinforcement learning algorithms.
items.abstract_zh: Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）是一种广泛使用的深度强化学习算法，它将熵正则化与演员-评论家架构相结合。标准实现依赖 Q 函数的一步时序差分学习，但其他评论家设计选择仍未得到充分探索。在本工作中，我们重新审视三种此类选择：学习软优势而非软 Q 值、使用多步回报目标，以及从回放缓冲区数据训练多步评论家。在保持策略目标固定的情况下，我们比较这些选择产生的六种评论家变体：(i) 优势评论家和 (ii) dueling 优势评论家，二者从一步转移学习；以及 λ-回报评论家和软广义优势估计（GAE）评论家，二者分别 (iii, iv) 在同策略下或 (v, vi) 从回放的轨迹片段中学习。每个变体在十四个任务上的完整随机超参数搜索中进行评估，并将超参数视为算法的一部分。学习软优势而非软 Q 值并不能提高性能，且软 GAE 评论家相对于更简单的 λ-回报评论家没有任何增益。确实能提高性能、且在连续控制上最明显的是，在回放的轨迹片段上训练 λ-回报评论家，即使不使用重要性加权或迹截断。这将早期证据——未校正的多步目标在回放下效果良好——扩展到完整的软 λ-回报，包括熵项。从设计上，这里研究的基本思想可扩展到 SAC 之外，我们的实证发现旨在鼓励将它们应用于更广泛的一类强化学习算法。

items.title_en: ELA: End-to-End Latent Action Policy Learning from Video Demonstrations
items.title_zh: ELA：从视频演示中进行端到端潜在动作策略学习
items.abstract_en: Robot imitation learning is limited by the scarcity of action-labeled data, while action-free demonstrations such as videos are abundant. Recent latent-action methods learn action-relevant representations from observation transitions, but they do not optimize latent actions for downstream control, leading to latent representations that are difficult for policies to model and difficult to accurately decode into continuous robot actions. This paper introduces ELA, an end-to-end framework for learning from video demonstrations via latent actions jointly optimized for policy learning and action decoding. ELA jointly trains a latent action model, latent action policy, and action decoder, enabling policies to leverage abundant video data with only a handful of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that ELA consistently outperforms prior latent action baselines. Moreover, it integrates seamlessly with existing imitation learning methods through lightweight 4M-parameter action decoders, requiring no changes to policy architectures or training objectives. Additional materials can be found on: https://end2end-latent-action.github.io/
items.abstract_zh: 机器人模仿学习受限于动作标注数据的稀缺性，而诸如视频之类的无动作演示数据却十分丰富。近期的潜在动作方法从观测转移中学习与动作相关的表示，但它们并未针对下游控制优化潜在动作，导致潜在表示难以被策略建模，也难以准确解码为连续的机器人动作。本文提出 ELA，一种通过为策略学习和动作解码联合优化的潜在动作从视频演示中学习的端到端框架。ELA 联合训练潜在动作模型、潜在动作策略和动作解码器，使策略能够利用丰富的视频数据，而仅需少量动作标注的机器人演示。在仿真和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，ELA 始终优于先前的潜在动作基线。此外，它通过轻量级 400 万参数的动作解码器与现有模仿学习方法无缝集成，无需改变策略架构或训练目标。更多材料见：https://end2end-latent-action.github.io/

items.title_en: LumiTac: Compact, High-Rate Six-Axis Optical Tactile Sensing for Human-Robot Interaction
items.title_zh: LumiTac：面向人机交互的紧凑型高速率六轴光学触觉传感
items.abstract_en: Integrating six-axis tactile feedback into robotic interfaces requires compact sensors with accurate load measurement and rapid online reconstruction. This paper presents LumiTac, a low-profile, camera-free optoelectronic tactile sensor combining spatially distributed illumination with spectral encoding. Five photoemitters and five RGBW photoreceivers are mounted on opposing circuit boards coupled through translucent silicone. Load-induced interlayer motion modulates the internal light field under compression, shear, bending, and torsion. The sensing head measures 12 mm in diameter and 4.75 mm in thickness, weighs less than 2 g, and has a component cost of approximately USD 7. A compact multilayer perceptron reconstructs three force and three moment components from 20 optical channels. Independent testing yielded coefficients of determination (R-squared) of 0.9657-0.9941, with mean absolute errors of 0.054-0.190 N for forces and 0.304-1.419 mN m for moments. Online prediction achieved an average update rate of 303.57 Hz and a median software processing latency of 0.722 ms. Experiments involving combined loading, light weights, and rapid tapping evaluated load tracking, sensitivity to small forces, and transient response, respectively. Robotic demonstrations further validated its applicability to tactile-guided manipulation and physical human-robot interaction. This study paves the way for compact, high-rate optical tactile sensing in robotic manipulation and human-robot interaction.
items.abstract_zh: 将六轴触觉反馈集成到机器人接口中，需要具有准确载荷测量和快速在线重建能力的紧凑传感器。本文提出 LumiTac，一种低剖面、无相机的光电子触觉传感器，它将空间分布照明与光谱编码相结合。五个光发射器和五个 RGBW 光接收器安装在相对的电路板上，并通过半透明硅胶耦合。由载荷引起的层间运动在压缩、剪切、弯曲和扭转下调制内部光场。传感头直径为 12 mm、厚度为 4.75 mm，重量小于 2 g，元件成本约为 7 美元。紧凑的多层感知机从 20 个光学通道重建三个力分量和三个力矩分量。独立测试得到的决定系数（R²）为 0.9657–0.9941，力的平均绝对误差为 0.054–0.190 N，力矩的平均绝对误差为 0.304–1.419 mN·m。在线预测实现了 303.57 Hz 的平均更新速率和 0.722 ms 的中位软件处理时延。涉及组合加载、轻重量和快速敲击的实验分别评估了载荷跟踪、对小力的敏感性和瞬态响应。机器人演示进一步验证了其在触觉引导操作和物理人机交互中的适用性。本研究为机器人操作和人机交互中的紧凑型高速率光学触觉传感铺平了道路。

items.title_en: Distributed Linear Bandits for Freshness-Aware Preprocessing in MEC-Enabled Digital Twin Networks
items.title_zh: 面向MEC使能数字孪生网络中新鲜度感知预处理的分布式线性老虎机
items.abstract_en: Digital twins (DTs) require timely updates from Internet of Things (IoT) devices to accurately represent the state of the corresponding physical systems, but transmitting large data volumes can compromise freshness. Moreover, different task classes have distinct computational demands and freshness requirements, while stochastic task generation and sizes complicate resource allocation. In this paper, we propose a freshness-aware framework in which multi-access edge computing (MEC) servers preprocess IoT data, reducing transmission volume and DT-server processing load. The framework establishes mutual support between DT and MEC servers. The DTs determine feasible CPU-allocation strategies guaranteeing class-specific age-of-information (AoI) requirements under specified workload, delay, and update-generation bounds. MEC servers collaboratively identify the feasible strategy minimizing expected freshness-normalized preprocessing delay. We formulate CPU-strategy selection as a fixed-confidence distributed best-arm identification problem in linear bandits, with MEC servers as agents and CPU allocations across task classes as arms. We employ DistLinGapE, a distributed collaborative learning method, to coordinate exploration and share observations. Numerical results show that the method identifies the optimal feasible strategy and reduces preprocessing delay when deployed under stationary task-class assignments and workload statistics. Collaboration yields an identification speedup nearly proportional to the number of participating MEC servers in the evaluated settings.
items.abstract_zh: 数字孪生（DT）需要来自物联网（IoT）设备的及时更新，以准确表示相应物理系统的状态，但传输大量数据可能损害新鲜度。此外，不同任务类别具有不同的计算需求和新鲜度要求，而随机任务生成和大小使资源分配复杂化。在本文中，我们提出一种新鲜度感知框架，其中多接入边缘计算（MEC）服务器预处理 IoT 数据，减少传输量和 DT 服务器处理负载。该框架在 DT 与 MEC 服务器之间建立相互支持。DT 确定可行的 CPU 分配策略，在指定工作负载、时延和更新生成界限下保证类别特定的信息年龄（AoI）要求。MEC 服务器协作识别使期望新鲜度归一化预处理时延最小的可行策略。我们将 CPU 策略选择建模为线性 bandit 中的固定置信度分布式最佳臂识别问题，其中 MEC 服务器作为智能体，跨任务类别的 CPU 分配作为臂。我们采用 DistLinGapE 这一分布式协作学习方法，以协调探索并共享观测。数值结果表明，在平稳任务类别分配和工作负载统计下部署时，该方法能够识别最优可行策略并降低预处理时延。在评估设置中，协作带来的识别加速几乎与参与的 MEC 服务器数量成正比。
